title: Linux Kernel Software Engineer - Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Join a world-class team of engineers building the next generation of enterprise storage solutions. As a key contributor, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, developing and optimizing the Linux kernel to push the boundaries of performance and reliability. You'll play a vital role in shaping the future of our products, collaborating with a brilliant team to solve complex challenges and deliver groundbreaking results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop new features within the  Linux kernel in support of Pure’s enterprise storage products.
  • Maintain and patch existing code to resolve difficult problems, including customer issues.
  • Optimize performance of the kernel within Pure’s arrays to meet customer requirements
  • Work cross-functionally and with partners and vendors, to diagnose and resolve problems at the boundary of hardware and software
  • Lead the architecture and development of software from initial concept to release, ensuring high-quality, resilient, and high-performance outcomes.
  • Collaborate and share knowledge with peers, providing mentorship as necessary.
  • Participate in code reviews and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements for upcoming enterprise storage server projects.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Deep, hands-on experience in Linux kernel and device driver development, with a proven ability to ship high-performance, resilient products. 
  • A strong foundation in computer architecture, operating systems, networking and core concepts like algorithms and data structures.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills, with a natural curiosity to explore, design, and validate your work.
  • The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally.
  • Experience in optimizing performance across various layers, including CPU instruction sets, NUMA, interrupt handling, and threading.
  • Preferred experience
    • Experience upstreaming your Linux kernel code
    • Experience in storage system concepts and related protocols, especially NVME and PCIe
    • Working with hardware vendors to resolve difficult problems
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

#LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations. 

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity. 

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is: $167,000—$246,000 USD

Accelerate Everpure’s AI momentum by transforming breakthrough infrastructure technology into high-impact digital experiences and technical narratives. In this strategic role, you will bridge modern AI frameworks and high-performance storage to define how enterprise technical leaders evaluate and adopt Everpure™ Data Stream Services, Portworx® by Everpure™, and our broader AI platform. By partnering closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Marketing, and Global Sales, you will establish the technical benchmark for AI data orchestration, converting complex architectures into clear market differentiation.

  • Drive AI Technical Content & Campaign Strategy: Architect and deliver high-impact technical assets—including deep-dive technical guides, interactive demonstrations, and webcasts—that demonstrate how the Everpure™ Platform speeds AI/ML pipelines and RAG architectures.
  • Build & Evangelize Hands-On Technical Showcases: Lead the strategy for interactive digital experiences on everpuredata.com, designing sandbox environments, TestDrive workflows, and live demonstrations for infrastructure architects and data engineers.
  • Equip Field Teams with Technical Enablement: Own the technical enablement toolkit for global sales and partners, creating high-fidelity reference architectures, sizing frameworks, and competitive technical toolkits for major enterprise deals.

  • Architectural & Framework Knowledge: Practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases (such as Milvus, Pinecone, or Weaviate), and high-throughput storage and networking protocols (S3, InfiniBand, Ethernet).
  • Technical Content & Storytelling Capabilities: Proven track record of converting complex engineering concepts into compelling technical narratives, reference architectures, and digital demonstrations for senior technical decision-makers. We'll invest in developing this if the AI depth is there.
  • Software & Scripting Skills: Proficiency in Python (focusing on AI/ML libraries) and Shell scripting to build, test, and maintain real-world technical demos and integration examples.

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Sales Hunter, Account Executive - (Central Government/Ministry of Defense)

Everpure Japan

Why this role, why now

AI is moving from pilot projects to the core of how the government works. But every AI initiative depends on one thing: data that is organized, fast, protected, and always available. That makes data infrastructure a strategic decision rather than a back-office purchase.

As a Sales Hunter on our Central Government team, you will sit at the center of that shift. You will open doors at Japan’s ministries and independent administrative institutions, and you will help shape the data foundation behind how the public sector adopts AI.

What you’ll do

  • Open new doors: Lead new business development with central government ministries and independent administrative institutions, together with channel resellers and key accounts.
  • Lead the AI-era conversation: Go beyond storage to discuss AI-ready data infrastructure, cyber resilience and rapid recovery, and efficient, sustainable data centers, and connect them to each customer’s mission.
  • Build trust that lasts: Develop long-term relationships with customers and lead our commitment to industry-leading customer satisfaction.
  • Orchestrate the win: Build and execute account plans, and lead Sales, Pre-sales, Partner Sales, and Field Marketing as one team to win new customers.
  • Navigate the public sector with confidence: Manage a healthy pipeline through procurement cycles and tender processes to consistently achieve quarterly and annual targets.
  • Grow with partners: Co-create opportunities with channel partners to extend our reach.
  • Work AI-natively: Use AI tools for account research, planning, and proposals to sharpen your productivity and the quality of every customer conversation.

What you bring

Must-have

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience focused on new customer acquisition or business development
  • Sales experience and industry knowledge in the Japanese public sector
  • A track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales, from executive management to data center operations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build deep trust
  • A consistent record of exceeding targets, recognized by customers and partners
  • Business-level Japanese and intermediate English reading comprehension

The mindset we value

  • Sincerity and genuine curiosity about public-sector customers’ challenges
  • A challenger mindset: insight and creativity that turn technology knowledge into proposals customers hadn’t considered
  • Curiosity about AI and a habit of continuous learning
  • Strategic thinking in planning and executing your territory
  • A team player who also cares about customer success after the contract is signed

Nice-to-have

  • Familiarity with government IT modernization, government cloud policy, government use of AI, and public-sector security requirements
  • Experience selling storage, data infrastructure, or cloud-related solutions
  • Understanding of AI and analytics workloads, data protection, and ransomware recovery

What you’ll gain

  • A front-row seat to the AI transformation of Japan’s public sector
  • Work that matters: infrastructure that supports the services citizens rely on
  • Close collaboration with Pre-sales, Partner Sales, and Field Marketing experts

title: Signal Integrity Hardware Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly motivated Hardware Signal Integrity (SI) Engineer for Everpure’s Datastore team. In this role, you will own high-speed signal integrity analysis, simulation, and measurement for enterprise SSD platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own signal integrity analysis for SSD hardware from architecture through production.
  • Drive board-level SI decisions, including: PCB material selection, via structures, loss tradeoffs, stackup definition and channel optimization.
  • Perform SI simulations including: Insertion loss (IL), return loss (RL), crosstalk, TDR / impedance profiles.
  • Lead TDR and S-parameter measurements, including: measurement setup, Calibration and de-embedding.
  • Perform 3D-EM extraction and simulation for vias, connectors, and complex channel structures.
  • Correlate simulation results with lab measurements to refine models and design assumptions.
  • Use and customize IBIS and IBIS-AMI models for PCIe, NAND and DDR channel analysis.
  • High speed signal eye diagram and margin analysis.
  • Support debug activities where SI is a contributing factor.
  • Perform Power Integrity (PI) simulations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with PCB design, system, firmware, mechanical, and test teams to ensure robust SI solutions.
  • Document SI design guidelines and best practices to enable scalable, repeatable designs.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in Signal Integrity engineering for high-speed systems.
  • B.S. Electrical or Computer Engineering (M.S. is a plus).
  • Strong SI simulation experience, must-have for PCIe and nice to have for NAND and DDR, for channel analysis, eye simulations, jitter, margin, etc.
  • Hands-on TDR and S-parameter measurement experience
  • Strong understanding of PCB design from an SI perspective, including materials, stackups, and via structures.
  • Deep experience with Simbeor (3D-EM extraction and simulation).
  • Ability to understand system design tradeoffs (SI, Performance, Mechanical, Thermal, Power).
  • Familiarity w/ SSD design w/ different form factors is a plus
  • Experience with SSD standard and compliance testing, ie PCI-SIG, NVMe, etc. is a plus
  • Detail oriented, analytical, process savvy, and customer focused yet flexible and adaptable to business needs
  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, technical development environment
  • Experience working in and leading cross-functional team
  • High level of teamwork and collaboration skills

title: Senior Partner Program Governance Manager
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a disciplined, systems-thinker to own the operating model that holds the Global Partner Program Center of Excellence together. This role is the backbone of how Everpure’s partner programs function at scale — ensuring that every program element is governed consistently, compliance is enforced rigorously, and the policies that guide exception decisions are clear, documented, and applied uniformly.

As Senior Partner Program Governance Manager, you will define and maintain the frameworks, policies, and processes that enable the rest of the program team to operate with discipline and confidence. You will not own readiness for each program area — that accountability sits with each program lead — but you will own the governance structure that ensures readiness is defined, measurable, and enforced.

You will work closely with the Resale, Managed Service, and Distribution program leads, as well as Channel Ops, Finance, Legal, and Sales leadership to ensure the partner program operates as a unified, compliant, and auditable system.

This role operates within the overall Global Partner Program Center of Excellence and is expected to operate as part of a coordinated system, not an independent program. You will be accountable for the governance structure and processes that enable consistent and scalable program execution. While you will manage the exception intake, review, and tracking process, final approval authority for program exceptions resides with the Director, Partner Program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Governance Framework and Operating Model

  • Define and maintain the governance framework for the Global Partner Program Center of Excellence, including RACIs, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating cadences
  • Establish and maintain cross-program standards that ensure consistency across all partner segments and routes-to-market
  • Own the program exception management process, including defining criteria, managing intake and review workflows, and ensuring decisions are documented and tracked. Facilitate decision-making, with final approval authority held by the Director, Partner Programs.
  • Analyze exception trends and identify systemic issues, providing recommendations to program leads and the Director, Partner Program to improve program design and reduce exception volume
  • Drive the program operating cadence including planning cycles, program reviews, and cross-functional alignment forums
  • Define compliance standards and enforcement frameworks, while program leads remain accountable for execution within those standards

Program Compliance

  • Define and maintain compliance standards across all partner program elements, ensuring consistent and auditable enforcement
  • Monitor partner compliance against program requirements and work with program leads to address gaps
  • Partner with Channel Ops on operational compliance tracking and reporting

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Kernel and Driver development team is responsible for several areas

  • Working for a team that deals primarily in various storage area network protocols such as Fiber Channel and Ethernet. 
  • On the initiator side, the team will be responsible for Linux initiator behavior attached to Flasharray. Focus is on NVME (ROCE, FC, TCP/IP) but also includes FC-SCSI (FCP) and iSCSI interfaces. This includes software development/fixes for Linux initiator stack, debugging initiator problems, and creating compatibility documents for Purity. For VMWare, focus is on debugging issues with VMWare as an initiator, and creating compatibility documentation.
  • For FibreChannel and NIC Drivers, focus is responsibility for FC-SCSI driver stack for storage side and responsibility for NIC drivers on networking side. This includes responsibility for related code, utilities, enhancements supporting RAS, as well as debugging failures found internally and in the field.
  • Maintain Linux kernels for internal testing
  • Documenting supported configurations for customers
  • Responsibility for evaluating Linux initiator behavior and optimizing for Pure Storage Flasharray. This includes correctness as well as optimizing for performances. Will contribute bug fixes and enhancements to Linux upstream. Analyze and debug difficult Linux bugs to optimize Flasharray attachment.
  • Responsible for maintaining Purity’s Fibre Channel SCSI (FCP) target driver. Maintenance includes driver updates for enhancements, bugs fixes and new hardware.
  • Resolve difficult Fibre Channel bugs found internally or externally and enhancing the resilience of Pure’s FC stack. This includes projects around multipathing and link health.
  • Responsible for maintaining NIC drivers on Pure’s storage systems. 
  • Dealing with middle ware C++ modules

  • Strong experience writing device drivers and/or kernel development for Linux/Unix. Prefer experience in storage and/or networking drivers
  • Minimum 5 years of development experience, but expect that typically candidates would have 15+ years experience. 
  • Experience designing and implementing significant components in storage protocol stacks and storage systems. 
  • Experience with storage protocols: either SCSI (FC-SCSI or iSCSI/FCP) and/or NVME Fabrics (NVME/ROCE, NVME/TCP or NVME/FC)  will be an advantage.

  • Experience with performance analysis/optimization for storage systems or protocols

  • Experience writing Linux storage device drivers, including some sets of Fibre Channel, NVME, ROCE, block and multipath modules.
  • Experience debugging difficult storage attach issues.
  • Experience with software development using C and C++, along with Python
  • Experience upstreaming Linux code is preferred
  • Should have experience developing test automation
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing storage performance

You will help define where and how Everpure wins in European healthcare and life sciences, then translate that strategy into field execution, organizational capability, customer engagement, partner motions, pipeline, and bookings.

You will lead the development of a multi-year EMEA HLS growth strategy across providers, payers, and life sciences. This includes identifying the most important market opportunities, shaping vertical and horizontal plays, and aligning Sales, SE, Marketing, Alliances, Product, and executive leadership around measurable outcomes.

This is a builder and operator role. You will personally advance the highest-priority customer and partner opportunities while also strengthening the people, coverage, operating rhythms, enablement, and ecosystem required to scale HLS growth beyond individual deals.

You will connect critical healthcare and life sciences priorities—including AI adoption, data modernization, clinical and research workloads, cyber resilience, cloud, and sovereign infrastructure—to differentiated business outcomes for customers. You will build executive credibility with customers and partners and help Everpure become the data platform of choice for European healthcare and life sciences.

What You’ll Do

Shape and execute the EMEA HLS growth strategy

  • Develop and maintain the regional HLS strategy, including priority countries, subsegments, accounts, routes to market, investment choices, and growth assumptions.

  • Translate market insight, customer priorities, regulatory requirements, and competitive dynamics into clear field plays and measurable business plans.

  • Balance growth across providers, payers, and life sciences while identifying the vertical and horizontal opportunities most likely to create repeatable regional growth.

  • Establish the operating cadence, metrics, and inspection rhythm required to track progress, address gaps, and adjust priorities.

Partner with Sales and Sales Engineering leadership

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to EMEA Sales and SE leaders on HLS priorities, executive engagement, technical focus areas, and resource allocation.

  • Align country sales, specialist SE, partner, marketing, and corporate teams around the highest-value strategic plays and initiatives.

  • Help leaders make explicit trade-offs about where to invest, where to stop, and how to scale what is working.

  • Turn strategy into practical technical plays, enablement, executive programs, and field actions that improve execution.

Own critical vertical and horizontal business development

  • Lead the most important HLS opportunities and strategic initiatives across Europe, from executive discovery through partner alignment, solution development, and commercial execution.

  • Connect HLS business problems to horizontal priorities such as AI, data platforms, cloud, cyber resilience, and sovereign infrastructure.

  • Create repeatable plays for workloads such as EHR, enterprise imaging, genomics, clinical AI, research, and regulated data environments.

  • Build and expand executive relationships with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to create pipeline, bookings, and referenceable outcomes.

Build the organization and operating model

  • Identify the talent, capability, and partner gaps that constrain HLS growth in EMEA.

  • Develop field capability through coaching, enablement, playbooks, communities of practice, and repeatable operating mechanisms.

  • Strengthen collaboration between country teams, specialist resources, Sales Engineering, Alliances, Marketing, Product, and executive leadership.

  • Build systems and relationships that continue to produce results beyond your direct involvement.

Develop and execute partner strategies

  • Design and operationalize joint go-to-market motions with strategic ISVs, hyperscalers, GSIs, resellers, and technology partners.

  • Define mutual objectives, roles, investments, target accounts, pipeline actions, and measures of success for priority partnerships.

  • Convert partner relationships into customer opportunities, closed business, technical validation, and referenceable outcomes.

  • Equip partner and field teams with the messaging, technical context, enablement, and commercial plays required to execute.

Represent Everpure in the market

  • Act as a senior voice for Everpure’s HLS strategy in customer meetings, executive briefings, industry events, analyst discussions, and partner forums.

  • Shape the market narrative around intelligent data foundations, healthcare AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign data platforms.

  • Bring customer and market insight back into regional and corporate strategy, product priorities, and field execution.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means you have:

  • Established a clear EMEA HLS growth strategy with explicit priorities, trade-offs, investments, and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Built trusted, productive partnerships with Sales and SE leaders across multiple European markets.

  • Improved the organization’s HLS capability through stronger talent, enablement, operating discipline, and partner capacity.

  • Created repeatable vertical and horizontal plays that generate pipeline, bookings, and customer references.

  • Personally advanced strategic customer and partner opportunities to measurable business results.

  • Expanded Everpure’s relevance across providers, payers, and life sciences through credible technical and executive engagement.

What You Bring

HLS and regional market expertise

  • Significant experience in healthcare and life sciences technology, with credibility across more than one HLS subsegment and a strong understanding of European market dynamics.

  • A working knowledge of healthcare regulation, data sovereignty, procurement, compliance, and the operating differences across European countries.

  • The ability to translate customer and market insight into a focused regional strategy and practical field execution.

Commercial and business-development ownership

  • A track record of owning or materially driving bookings, pipeline, customer growth, or business performance with specific, recent examples.

  • Experience leading complex customer opportunities and converting strategic relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The judgment to distinguish between activity, influence, pipeline creation, and closed business.

Technical and solution fluency

  • Credibility discussing production data and AI platforms, including architecture, workload characteristics, scale, deployment models, security, and sovereignty.

  • Sufficient depth across relevant healthcare workloads—such as EHR, imaging, genomics, clinical AI, research, or regulated data—to engage customers, SE leaders, and partners in substantive conversations.

  • The ability to connect technical choices to customer outcomes, business value, and a compelling route to adoption.

Leadership partnership and organization development

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior Sales, SE, partner, and executive leaders without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience building capability that scales beyond your individual contribution, such as talent, enablement, governance, partner ecosystems, or operating mechanisms.

  • A collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented leadership style suited to a multi-country, cross-functional EMEA environment.

Alliance and ecosystem execution

  • Experience creating and executing joint go-to-market strategies with strategic partners, with clear mutual commitments and measurable results.

  • The ability to work across ISVs, hyperscalers, GSIs, resellers, and technology partners depending on the customer problem and route to market.

  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

We operate in a hybrid and field-based model. You will be expected to work effectively from a regional corporate office or key EMEA market and travel approximately 25–40% across the region as business needs require.

title: Sales District Director, Enterprise Sales Division
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

セールス ディストリクト ディレクター (エンタープライズ営業部 / ハイタッチセールス)  * English version follows

勤務地: 東京(千代田区永田町)  

レポートライン: 日本RVP Sales(営業統括責任者) 

このポジションの魅力 

  • 成長フェーズにある企業で、ひとつの営業組織を率いるポジションです。事業計画・戦略の立案から、メンバーのマネジメント、将来の採用まで幅広く担い、チームの成長に大きな裁量を持って関わることができます。 
  • AI・データマネジメントソリューション事業と、フラッシュメモリーストレージ・インフラ事業の両方に携わることができます。 

ポジション概要 

Everpureは現在成長を続けており、日本のエンタープライズ営業チームを率いるセールスディストリクトディレクターを募集しています。国内企業がAI活用、サイバーレジリエンス、ハイブリッドクラウド運用に向けてデータ基盤の刷新を進めるなか、本ポジションは、お客様への価値提供のあり方を形づくる役割を担います。 

高いパフォーマンスを発揮するアカウントエグゼクティブ(AE)チームを構築・育成し、売上予測、テリトリー戦略、新規顧客開拓、チャネルパートナーの拡大といった成果に責任を持っていただきます。エンタープライズAE 3〜5名とインサイドセールス1名のマネジメントに加え、専任のプリセールスエンジニアと緊密に連携します。大手企業のIT部門責任者との信頼関係を築き、長期かつ複雑な商談をチームとともに推進し、組織としての取り組みを受注へとつなげていくことがミッションです。 

主な業務内容 

  • 大手顧客を担当するエンタープライズAE (Account Executive)チームをリードし、育成する。Everpureのカルチャーとバリューをチームの日々の活動に根づかせる。 
  • 事業の成長に合わせて、AEの採用とオンボーディングを行う。 
  • AI活用に向けたデータ基盤整備、サイバーレジリエンス、ハイブリッド/マルチクラウドのデータ管理といったテーマで、チームが戦略的な提案を行えるよう支援する。 
  • セールスエンジニア、パートナーアカウントマネージャー、インサイドセールスなど、関連部門と連携し、顧客戦略とパートナー戦略を整合させる。 
  • 主要KPI(パイプライン拡大、パートナーとの連携、売上予測の精度、PoC管理)の達成を牽引し、目標の4倍以上のパイプラインを維持する。 
  • ディストリビューター、リセラー、システムインテグレーター(SIer)などのチャネルパートナーについて、経営層、営業責任者、営業担当者との関係を構築・深化させ、共同でアカウントプランニングと案件開拓を行う。 
  • 主要な顧客・パートナーとの商談に自ら同席して範を示し、メンバー全員が目標達成・超過達成できるようコーチングする。 
  • 東京都内および全国のお客様・パートナー先へ定期的に訪問し、現場に近い立場で事業を推進する。 
  • 年間の受注目標、新規顧客獲得、AEの営業目標達成を実現する。 
  • 週次でアクティビティとパイプラインの状況をレビューし、課題を早期に把握して解消する。 
  • データやAIを活用した営業ツールも取り入れながら分析的に課題を解決し、チームの戦略を策定する。 
  • 明確さ・一貫性・説明責任をもってパフォーマンスをマネジメントする。 

求める経験・スキル 

  • ハイテク業界(AI、データマネジメント、ソフトウェア、SaaSなど)における、フィールドセールスのマネジメント経験5年以上 
  • 競争の激しい市場における、ストレージまたはコアITインフラ領域での営業マネジメント経験(尚可) 
  • 大手企業のIT部門およびIT部門責任者への営業実績 
  • 日本のSIerおよびディストリビューターのエコシステムにおける、パートナー経由の営業モデルの構築・運営経験 
  • 優秀な営業人材の採用、育成、定着に成功した実績 
  • 経営層に対しても、Everpureの価値を明確かつ説得力をもって伝えられる、優れた文章力・コミュニケーション力 
  • 高い組織運営力を持ち、プロセスを重視し、細部まで丁寧に取り組む姿勢 
  • 複数の優先事項を適切に判断し、問題の本質に迫る力 
  • 複雑な営業戦略を遂行するために、社内リソース(SE、サポート、マーケティング、グローバルチーム)を動かす力 
  • CRMおよびセールスイネーブルメントツールの活用スキル 

語学要件 

  • 日本語: ネイティブレベル(国内のお客様・パートナーとのやり取りのため) 
  • 英語: 日常会話レベル(グローバルチームとの連携のため) 

勤務形態 

東京オフィス(永田町)での出社を基本とします。ただし、承認された休暇、出張、その他承認された休業期間は除きます。詳細はEverpureの社内規定に従います。 

Position:  Sales District Director, Enterprise Sales Team (Hi-Touch) 

Location: Tokyo (Nagatacho, Chiyoda-ku) 

Reports to: RVP Sales, Japan 

Why This Role 

  • Lead your own sales division at a growing company. You will own business planning and strategy, people management, and future recruiting, with real influence over how the team grows 
  • This opportunity lets you experience both the AI & Data Management Solutions business and the flash memory storage and infrastructure business

About the Role 

Everpure is growing, and we are hiring a Sales District Director to lead one of our enterprise sales teams in Japan. As Japanese enterprises modernize their data infrastructure for AI adoption, cyber resilience, and hybrid cloud operations, this role will shape how we serve them. 

You will build and grow a high-performing team of Account Executives (AEs) and own results across forecasting, territory strategy, new account development, and channel partner growth. You will manage three to five Enterprise AEs and one Inside Sales Representative, and work closely with a dedicated Pre-Sales Engineer. You will build trust with IT leaders at major Japanese enterprises, guide the team through complex, long-cycle deals, and turn coordinated effort into closed business. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Lead and develop a team of Enterprise AEs serving major customers, embedding Everpure’s culture and values in how the team works 
  • Hire and onboard additional AEs as the business grows 
  • Equip the team to lead strategic conversations on AI and data readiness, cyber resilience, and hybrid and multi-cloud data management 
  • Collaborate with the extended district sales team, including Systems Engineers, Partner Account Managers, and Inside Sales, to align customer and partner strategy 
  • Drive team performance against key KPIs (pipeline growth, partner alignment, forecast accuracy, and POC management), maintaining a pipeline of at least 4x quota 
  • Build and deepen relationships with channel partners (distributors, resellers, and system integrators), including their executives, sales leaders, and AEs, and jointly plan and develop accounts with them 
  • Lead by example by joining key customer and partner meetings and coaching every team member to meet or exceed quota 
  • Travel regularly to customer and partner sites, within Tokyo and across Japan, to stay close to the business 
  • Deliver annual bookings targets, new logo growth, and AE quota attainment. 
  • Run weekly activity and pipeline reviews to identify and close gaps early 
  • Apply analytical thinking, including data and AI-enabled sales tools, to solve problems and shape team strategy 
  • Manage performance with clarity, consistency, and accountability 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of field sales management experience in the high-tech industry, such as AI, data management, software, or SaaS 
  • Sales management experience in storage or core IT infrastructure in a competitive market is a strong plus 
  • A track record of selling to IT departments and IT leadership at large enterprise accounts 
  • Experience building and managing partner-led sales motions within Japan’s system integrator and distributor ecosystem 
  • Proven success recruiting, coaching, and retaining strong sales talent 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate Everpure’s value clearly and credibly to executives 
  • A strong organizational, process-driven, and detail-oriented approach 
  • Sound judgment in balancing competing priorities and getting to the root of problems 
  • The ability to mobilize internal resources (system engineers, support, marketing and global teams) to execute complex sales strategies 
  • Fluency with CRM and sales enablement tools 

Language Requirements 

  • Japanese: Native level, for working with Japanese customers and partners 
  • English: Conversational level, for collaborating with global teams 

Work Style 

This is primarily an in-office role based in the Tokyo office (Nagatacho), per Everpure’s policies, except during approved PTO, business travel, or other approved leave

title: System Software Engineer, Cloud (C++/Python)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure Cloud Dedicated (formerly Cloud Block Store) is Pure’s enterprise storage solution running in the public cloud. It brings the same features customers know from FlashArray - like data reduction (deduplication and compression), snapshots, encryption, and replication - directly into AWS and Azure. Because we reduce how much data actually needs to be stored and how many native cloud disks are required, customers can run their workloads in the cloud with lower storage cost and predictable performance instead of over‑provisioning native cloud volumes.

The service has been in production since 2019, serving enterprise, SaaS, and multicloud customers. It also acts as the storage engine for other Everpure Cloud offerings, such as Everpure Cloud Azure Native, where Azure users consume Pure storage as a native Azure service.

Our Prague‑based team owns the project on both AWS and Azure end‑to‑end. We design and build the core storage architecture, handle resiliency and performance work, and drive deployment and upgrade mechanisms. We also work closely with product managers, support, and field teams on customer issues and roadmap priorities. Because we run on top of AWS and Azure, we must deeply understand their building blocks (VMs, disks, networking, databases) and how Purity behaves on top of them.

For this role, we are looking for engineers who are curious about how things really work in the cloud, enjoy solving complex distributed‑systems problems, and are comfortable in a fast‑changing environment. Unlike traditional hardware projects, our work has to keep pace with new cloud services and features. You will help us evaluate new AWS and Azure capabilities and integrate them into our product to improve resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency for customers - while keeping the familiar, “FlashArray‑like” experience that Pure is known for.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, implement, and review new features in the Everpure Cloud Dedicated data path, primarily in C++ and/or Python, running on AWS and Azure.
  • Improve the resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency of our cloud storage stack (failover behavior, HA, capacity expansion, data reduction, cloud‑specific optimizations).

THE ROLE

As a Technical Services Engineer for Portworx® by Everpure™, you will empower innovators and enterprise customers to seamlessly deploy and scale multi-cloud data services for Kubernetes and containerized applications. In this high-impact role, you will redefine the cloud-native storage experience by bridging deep technical expertise with direct customer engagement. You will serve as a technical expert across all deployment phases, partnering closely with customer engineers, account teams, and core R&D to solve complex cloud-native architecture challenges.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Drive Enterprise Customer Success: Deliver end-to-end technical expertise across all stages of Portworx® deployment and production environments, ensuring rapid issue resolution, minimal downtime, and maximum platform reliability for key enterprise accounts.
  • Perform Complex Problem Diagnosis & Triage: Analyze application workflows, system logs, and containerized workloads across public/private cloud stacks to isolate, reproduce, and resolve multi-layer technical issues alongside engineering teams.
  • Enable Pre-Sales and Onboarding: Partner with field systems engineers to guide technical installation, integration, and proof-of-concept (POC) execution for prospective and onboarding enterprise clients.
  • Scale Organizational Knowledge: Author and maintain high-impact knowledge base articles, technical documentation, and FAQ guides to build self-service capabilities for customers and streamline internal support workflows.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Demonstrable expertise in customer-facing technical support, site reliability engineering (SRE), or cloud systems engineering within enterprise software environments.
  • Deep practical knowledge of container orchestration platforms (such as Kubernetes, OpenShift, or VMware Tanzu) and major public cloud ecosystems (such as AWS or Azure).
  • Proficiency with modern Infrastructure-as-Code and DevOps tools (such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet) and Linux to troubleshoot complex software stacks and automation workflows.
  • Outstanding cross-functional communication and technical consultation skills, with a track record of effectively managing customer escalations and translating technical challenges into actionable engineering solutions.
  • Flexibility to participate in team shift structures and on-call rotation schedules as required to support mission-critical global infrastructure.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering, Portworx
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Portworx is building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to embed directly with our most strategic customers during their highest-stakes Kubernetes storage deployments. You'll be the technical bridge between complex customer infrastructure and Portworx itself: shaping production architectures, advising through critical rollouts, and turning field experience into structured product feedback that shapes our roadmap.

This is a consultative role. The customer's teams operate their own environment; your job is to make sure the decisions they make are the right ones. That means the value you bring is judgment and depth rather than execution: knowing which architecture holds under load and failure, which assumptions in a proposed design are wrong, and what a given storage fabric, hypervisor estate, or network topology will and won't support.

Most of this work sits in the customer's own data center. Our largest and most complex deployments run on customer-owned compute, Fibre Channel and IP storage fabrics, established virtualization estates, and enterprise network designs that predate Kubernetes by a decade. You need to be genuinely conversant below the Kubernetes layer, at the server, the HBA, the switch, and the array, because that is where these deployments succeed or fail and where the customer's infrastructure leaders will test whether you're worth listening to.

This is not a support role and not a pure pre-sales role. You'll own engagements end-to-end: from solution validation before you ever get on a plane, through architecture design, production readiness, and a clean handoff. You'll leave behind documentation and decision guidance that make the next customer's journey faster.

Just as important as the technical substance: this is a relationship-building role. Day to day you'll work alongside the customer's platform and infrastructure teams, mostly their senior engineers, leads, and architects. You'll also engage directly with the Directors and VPs of Infrastructure and Platform Engineering who set platform direction, and the goal is to become a trusted advisor on that broader strategy, not just their Portworx footprint. Done well, this role earns Portworx (and Pure) real standing and visibility across the customer's platform organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and review production Portworx architectures for complex, high-stakes environments: bare metal and virtualized on-prem estates, multi-cluster and DR topologies, KubeVirt VM migration, regulated and air-gapped deployments, and hybrid footprints where customers also run cloud or CaaS
  • Pressure-test the customer's intended design against the compute, storage fabric, hypervisor, and network they actually have, and tell them plainly where it won't hold
  • Advise on the decisions that determine whether a deployment survives contact with production: storage class design, KVDB topology, snapshot and backup policy, replication mode and placement, capacity and sizing
  • Guide the customer's infrastructure and platform teams through the layers underneath Portworx: LUN presentation and masking, multipath behavior, LVM layout, HBA and NIC choices, MTU and bonding, VLAN and routing boundaries, hypervisor datastore and passthrough decisions. Their engineers execute; you make sure the design is sound and the tradeoffs are understood
  • Where it strengthens the recommendation, validate an architecture pattern in a lab before traveling on-site, so advice rests on something tested rather than assumed
  • Define the failure-mode and performance validation plan before go-live (node, rack, and AZ loss, path and fabric failure, network partition, upgrade paths), then interpret the results with the customer
  • Act as the senior technical voice during critical rollouts and live escalations: direct the diagnosis, frame the decision, and pull in Support and Engineering when the problem belongs to them
  • Author reference architectures, runbooks, and decision frameworks that become reusable IP across engagements
  • Upskill customer platform teams so they can operate independently post-handoff
  • Build and sustain relationships across the customer's platform organization: daily with the senior engineers, leads, and architects you work beside, and directly with the Directors and VPs of Infrastructure and Platform Engineering, by understanding and helping shape where their platform is headed rather than only where Portworx sits in it
  • Conduct periodic visits to established, already-live accounts to maintain the relationship, stay current on their evolving platform needs, and surface expansion opportunities. Many customers start small and grow, and this is how that growth gets found and won
  • Develop enough fluency in the customer's development environment and workflows to speak credibly to their platform needs as a whole
  • Log and structure field feedback (bugs, feature gaps, roadmap signal) for a recurring feedback loop with Product and Engineering
  • Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to triage which engagements warrant FDE involvement
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, Chicago, or New York office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave

WHAT YOU BRING

The depth below is what the role runs on. We expect you to have earned it by operating this infrastructure yourself earlier in your career, because customers can tell the difference between someone who has run it and someone who has read about it.

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering, SRE, architecture, or field and solutions engineering roles; prior "forward deployed," field engineering, or professional services experience a plus
  • Must have Unix & Linux administrator experience
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise (CKA/CKS or equivalent), grounded in having run clusters in production rather than in a lab
  • Strong command of enterprise storage: Fibre Channel SAN (zoning, WWPNs, fabric login and path behavior), iSCSI, NVMe/TCP, NAS protocols, dm-multipath, LVM, and array-side provisioning, masking, and mapping
  • Real understanding of compute and server hardware: bare metal provisioning and lifecycle, BIOS, firmware and driver management, HBA and NIC selection, NUMA and CPU/memory topology, local NVMe layout and endurance
  • Production-grade virtualization knowledge, ideally VMware vSphere and ESXi (datastores, VMFS, vVols, HA and DRS behavior, resource contention), plus an understanding of KubeVirt as a migration target
  • Practical data center networking: VLANs and trunking, MTU and jumbo frames, bonding and LACP, L2 versus L3 boundaries, routing, load balancer integration, and how partitions, congestion, and asymmetric paths present in a distributed storage system
  • Solid Linux systems background extending to the block and device layers: udev, kernel and sysctl tuning, systemd, I/O scheduling, and performance triage with tools like iostat, blktrace, and perf
  • Familiarity with cloud and managed Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift) is useful, since many customers run a hybrid footprint, but on-prem depth is what this role is built around
  • Working understanding of customer development environments (CI/CD, application deployment patterns, dev and test workflows) sufficient to reason about platform needs beyond just the storage layer
  • Prior experience with Portworx, other CSI-based storage platforms, or enterprise storage vendors (Pure Storage, NetApp, Dell, etc.) is highly valued
  • Genuine relationship-building instincts. Trust is earned with the engineers and leads you work beside and has to extend to the senior leaders above them; this is a relationship you sustain, not a project you close out. Comfort running both a technical whiteboard session and a live war-room call, and staying in touch between fires
  • The judgment to know when to advise and when to step back. You'll spend more time shaping decisions and teaching than typing at a customer's keyboard
  • Strong technical writing skills. The artifacts you leave behind are as important as the advice you gave in the room.

#LI-ONSITE

Actual base pay within this range will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. descriptionHtml:

THE ROLE

Everpure is moving from an application-centric world to a data-centric one — where AI depends on trusted, well-governed, and contextualized data across the business. As part of this shift, we're looking for a Staff Analyst, AI & Automation to lead the technical build of AI and applied ML capability inside the analytics function.

This is an individual contributor role — you will not manage people. Your leverage comes from what you build and ship: AI agents, applied ML models, and automated analytics workflows that change how insight gets produced, working closely with cross-functional teams to bring these to life.

AI is changing by the week, not by the year. We're not looking for someone who adopts AI once it's already mainstream — we want someone who is naturally ahead of the curve: scanning what's new, testing it quickly, and bringing it into the team before it's obvious to everyone else. This role has real freedom to experiment, rethink existing approaches, and change course as the field moves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the technical build of AI-powered analytics tools — including RAG pipelines, LLM-assisted querying, agent workflows, and applied ML models. Our current stack includes Glean, Gemini, Claude Code and Snowflake Cortex, and we expect that to change; we care more that you pick up new tools quickly than that you already know ours.
  • Apply data science methods (forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection, classification) where a problem genuinely calls for them — though the core of this role is LLM- and agent-based automation rather than classical modelling.
  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents for analytics use cases — e.g. agents that answer business questions from data, auto-generate insights, flag anomalies, or draft recurring reports without manual pull.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to automate manual, repetitive analytics work with AI, and independently prototype, test, and productionize those solutions.
  • Propose and maintain a rolling technical roadmap for AI and data science work in the analytics function — a living document you revisit and adjust as the field moves, not a fixed annual plan.
  • Write the SQL/Python needed to support your own models and analysis, collaborating with the broader technical organization on any shared systems your work touches.
  • Champion data governance and AI-readiness practices — data quality, semantic context, lineage — so AI agents and models are working from trustworthy, well-understood data.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to scope problems, and with IT/engineering/data platform teams to ensure AI and automation initiatives are supportable at scale.
  • Pair with and review the work of other analysts applying data science and AI methods — sharing technical judgment through collaboration, not people management.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of experience across data science, applied AI/ML, or advanced analytics, with a track record of Staff-level individual-contributor technical ownership.
  • Bachelor's degree in statistics, computer science, math, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Strong Python skills for data science and automation — comfortable with libraries like pandas, scikit-learn, and building/calling ML models, not just scripting.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents — e.g. RAG pipelines, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, or tool-calling — and shipping something people actually use, not just experimenting.
  • Strong SQL skills to support your own models and analysis, and enough data modeling fluency to work well with broader technical teams.
  • In your application, tell us about something you built with LLMs in the last 6 months that people actually use — what it does, who uses it, and how often.
  • High adaptability: comfortable dropping an approach that's no longer the best one, learning a new tool quickly, and adjusting plans as the AI landscape shifts, sometimes within the same quarter.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain data science/AI concepts and trade-offs in a way that builds confidence with non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
  • Strong ownership mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, prioritizing across competing asks, and driving projects independently.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) or building multi-step autonomous agents.
  • Experience with MLOps practices — model monitoring, versioning, or deployment pipelines.
  • Exposure to data governance, semantic data modeling, or data classification concepts (e.g. knowledge graphs, metadata tagging).

We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech, fundamentally reshaping the cloud-native, modern virtualization, and AI infrastructure landscape. Here, you’ll lead with innovative thinking, grow alongside us, and work with some of the smartest minds in the industry.
We’re looking for engineers passionate about system testing, distributed systems, Kubernetes, storage, modern virtualization, AI workloads, and automation. You’ll work on complex, real-world scenarios involving HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, scalability, and failure testing across large-scale Kubernetes environments.
As enterprises modernize their infrastructure, containers, virtual machines, and AI/ML workloads are increasingly converging on Kubernetes. From traditional enterprise applications and VMs to GPU-accelerated AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads, Kubernetes is rapidly becoming the common platform for running the next generation of applications.
This role gives you the opportunity to test and influence how Portworx delivers enterprise-grade storage, data protection, availability, and resiliency across these workloads—including containerized applications, KubeVirt/OpenShift Virtualization VMs, and demanding AI/ML workloads running on Kubernetes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:
  • Own system-level quality for Portworx Enterprise across Kubernetes, storage, and modern virtualization environments.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test strategies, and automation for multiple concurrent product and feature releases.
  • Build and maintain scalable automation test suites, with a strong focus on Golang-based automation and code quality.
  • Drive validation of HA, resiliency, disaster recovery, upgrades, scale, and failure scenarios in large-scale Kubernetes environments.
  • Identify functional and automation coverage gaps, assess risks early, and drive improvements to overall product quality.
  • Collaborate with development, QE, and architecture teams across geographies to troubleshoot complex system-level issues and ensure timely releases.
  • Ensure CI/CD pipelines and automation infrastructure effectively execute the required functional, regression and system test strategies.

  • WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE: 

    • Strong SDET mindset — engineering for quality and ability to design complex distributed system test failure scenarios
    • Ability to lead by example and take end-to-end ownership of product quality.
    • Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Golang, with Python experience also valuable.
    • Strong debugging skills across Kubernetes, Linux, storage, virtualization .
    • Ability to work on multiple concurrent product/feature releases.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
    • Ability to mentor engineers, conduct automation/code reviews.

    MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS : 
    • BS/MS with 8+ years of software testing/SDET experience, preferably involving distributed systems, infrastructure, storage, or virtualization.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Kubernetes application lifecycle management.
    • Experience working with VMWare/HyperV , KubeVirt or Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization is highly desirable.
    • Strong background in enterprise storage (file/block/Object) and Kubernetes persistent storage/CSI.
    • Strong Golang and/or Python programming skills, with Golang preferred.
    • Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Experience with Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift, EKS, AKS, or GKE is a plus.
    • Working experience with public clouds such as AWS., Azure and Google Cloud is preferable.
    • Experience with tools such as Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, X-ray is preferable.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

The Strategy, Corporate Development & Ventures team reports directly to the Chief Technology and Growth Officer (CTGO). At the frontier of data and AI, strategy must be closely coupled with technology. The department supports a broad mandate of M&A, strategic investments, commercial partnerships and business development across the data and AI software stack, AI infrastructure supply chain, hyperscalers, neoclouds, and the enterprise - across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments.

Strategically we will embed directly and deeply with our business units. The team works directly alongside the engineers and technologists who built the Everpure platform, enabling deep, direct technical evaluation of markets and companies as the agent infrastructure of tomorrow evolves. 

Everpure is significantly expanding its corporate development capability, with strong executive sponsorship and committed capital - this team is being built now, and its early members will shape how it operates.

THE ROLE

Reporting to the VP of Strategy, Corporate Development & Ventures, the Director will own transactions and coverage areas end-to-end, from market assessment and proactive sourcing through diligence, structuring, negotiation, and post-close accountability. This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership and direct executive exposure. On transactions, the Director will lead deal teams staffed with Senior Manager- and Associate-level colleagues, directing their work across modeling, diligence, and materials preparation; as the function scales, the role is expected to grow in leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain a proactive pipeline of acquisition and investment opportunities across the data and AI landscape, developing relationships with founders, investors, and advisors to source opportunities ahead of formal processes
  • Lead transaction execution: valuation and financial modeling, cross-functional diligence coordination with product, engineering, legal, and finance, negotiation support, and structuring across M&A and venture instruments
  • Direct and develop deal team members across transaction workstreams, reviewing analytical output and building the team's execution standards
  • Develop rigorous, well-researched perspectives on adjacent markets and competitors to inform build, buy, and partner decisions
  • Define integration milestones and success metrics prior to close, and evaluate post-close performance against the original investment thesis
  • Prepare executive- and board-level materials covering pipeline, transaction evaluation, and portfolio performance
  • Contribute to building the team's AI-enabled deal processes and market intelligence capabilities, leveraging Everpure's own platform

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8–12 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or venture capital, with substantial buy-side transaction experience and demonstrated end-to-end deal ownership
  • Strong financial modeling and valuation capabilities, with working command of transaction mechanics including deal structures and diligence
  • Ability to develop technical fluency rapidly in enterprise infrastructure; experience in storage, data management, or AI infrastructure is a plus
  • Proficiency applying AI tools to research, analysis, and transaction evaluation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for executive audiences
  • An established network across founders, investors, and advisors that supports proprietary deal sourcing
  • Experience directing junior deal team members and reviewing analytical work product

This position is based in our Santa Clara, CA office.

descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure（旧 Pure Storage）では、日本市場におけるさらなる事業成長の実現に向けて、国内の大手システムインテグレーター（SIer）および販売パートナーとのビジネス拡大をリードいただくパートナーアカウントマネージャー（PAM）を募集しています。

本ポジションは、パートナーテクニカルマネージャー（PTM）と連携しながら、担当パートナーとの中長期的な関係構築と事業成長を推進する重要な役割です。営業、技術、マーケティング、サポート、チャネル部門など社内の各チームと密接に連携し、パートナー企業との協業を通じて市場でのビジネス拡大を実現していただきます。

職務内容

パートナー戦略の立案およびビジネス拡大の推進

担当する大手SIer・販売パートナーと中長期的な成長戦略を策定し、共同ビジネスの拡大を推進します。

  • パートナーの事業戦略や市場動向、業界トレンドを踏まえたビジネス機会の発掘
  • Everpureのグローバルおよびリージョナル戦略と連動した成長計画の策定
  • 具体的なアクションプランの立案・実行および成果創出

You will be the vital technical bridge between our innovative solutions and customer success, utilizing deep technical expertise to drive sales and deliver complex Professional Services across the ANZ. As a Technical Design Architect, you will work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Service teams, becoming a trusted advisor who scopes, sells, and implements strategic solutions for our customers' most challenging data infrastructure problems. Your mission is to translate business needs into powerful, real-world technical outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and Deliver Strategic Solutions: Lead the technical scoping, design, and hands-on delivery of complex, large-scale Professional Services solutions, focusing on data migration, replication, and clustering for homogeneous and heterogeneous environments.
  • Drive Pre- and Post-Sales Technical Strategy: Act as a high-level technical consultant to both internal sales teams and external customers, participating in customer evaluations and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to ensure our solutions meet future business continuity and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Automate and Optimize Customer Environments: Develop and implement scripting and automation solutions (e.g., in Python or for APIs) to seamlessly integrate Pure Storage into a customer’s operational environment and streamline data migration and replication processes.
  • Influence Technical Direction and Standards: Advise sales and engineering on emerging developments and best practices in replication, clustering, and data migrations, ensuring solutions are aligned with industry-leading DR/BCP standards and client needs.
  • Serve as a Technical Expert and Collaborator: Leverage your deep understanding of IT architecture, networking, and cloud offerings to present targeted, architecture-level solutions, and contribute significant technical content to critical sales documents (RFPs, RFQs).

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of overall technical experience and 5+ years as an SME / solutions architect in ANZ.
    Expert-level Storage and Data Management: Proven, in-depth knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, etc.) and significant experience with replication, clustering, and disaster recovery technologies (e.g., Zerto, Veeam, Veritas).
  • Proficiency in Automation and Scripting: Demonstrated ability to develop and apply scripting for system integrations and process automation, particularly using Python, Ansible, and Terraform with APIs.
  • Advanced Platform and OS Experience: Extensive experience with managing and integrating systems on various operating systems, including Windows, AIX, and Linux, and familiarity with VMWare ESX (SRM) and Hyper-V environments.
  • Complex Solution Architecture: A strong background in data center migrations/consolidations and the ability to apply comprehensive knowledge of networking concepts (e.g., Nexus, ACI) and multi-vendor server/storage platforms to design and implement complex, highly performant technical solutions.

title: Director, Free Cash Flow & Working Capital Planning
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is building a new enterprise cash flow planning capability within Corporate Treasury, and we are looking for a Director to lead it from the ground up.

As our business evolves toward a greater mix of consumption and as-a-service models, new legal entities and centralized procurement structures, increased capital investment, and more complex supply chain dynamics, understanding and optimizing cash generation has become increasingly important.

Reporting to the Corporate Treasurer, you will own how Everpure forecasts, explains, and improves free cash flow end to end. You will build the models, data foundation, operating cadence, and ultimately the team responsible for this capability. You will partner closely with Corporate FP&A, Accounting, Supply Chain, Operations, Investor Relations, and senior Finance leadership, with meaningful influence over capital allocation, liquidity planning, and operating decisions.

Success in this role will be measured not only by forecast accuracy, but by the quality of insight delivered to decision-makers and your ability to build a durable, scalable capability that connects enterprise financial planning with cash management and business performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and own Everpure's integrated three-statement forecast, with primary accountability for balance sheet and cash flow forecasting across monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-range planning horizons.
  • Establish a driver-based free cash flow model connecting operating performance, working capital, capital expenditures, financing activity, and taxes into a single, defensible view of cash generation.
  • Partner with Treasury to connect direct and indirect cash forecasting, reconciling short-term liquidity views with longer-range financial planning.
  • Establish forecast accuracy metrics and disciplined variance reviews, continuously improving forecasting methodology, assumptions, and cycle times.
  • Build the analytical framework for working capital across inventory, receivables, payables, deferred revenue, deferred costs, purchase commitments, and the broader cash conversion cycle.
  • Model the cash and balance sheet implications of evolving business models and legal entity structures, including subscription and consumption models, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, inventory ownership, payment terms, and timing differences between revenue and cash.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Sales Finance, and Accounting to translate operational drivers such as build plans, component and commodity costs, purchase commitments, billing terms, and collections into actionable cash insights and measurable working capital improvements.
  • Own capital expenditure forecasting and prioritization across platform development, product qualification, R&D infrastructure, facilities, and IT, including business case evaluation, ROI and payback analysis, and post-investment tracking.
  • Develop cash flow and balance sheet insights for executive leadership, Board and Audit Committee materials, and partner with Investor Relations and Treasury on external free cash flow guidance and related metrics.
  • Support M&A, financing, and other strategic transactions through cash flow, working capital, and balance sheet modeling and diligence.
  • Build the systems and data foundation for the function, partnering with Finance Systems and IT to evolve from spreadsheet-dependent processes toward scalable planning platforms, integrated data, automated reporting, and governed workflows.
  • Establish the operating cadence and governance for enterprise cash forecasting, including ownership, inputs, review forums, controls, dashboards, KPIs, and documentation.
  • Build and scale the function as a hands-on player-coach, defining the operating model and future team structure while remaining deeply engaged in the models, data, and analysis.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor across Finance and the broader business, bringing a clear point of view on cash performance, challenging assumptions constructively, and translating complex financial dynamics into actionable recommendations.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 12+ years of progressively complex finance experience, including significant Corporate FP&A experience and demonstrated ownership of cash flow and balance sheet forecasting at scale.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in working capital mechanics, including inventory, receivables, payables, purchase commitments, and cash conversion cycle management.
  • Experience operating in a hardware, manufacturing, or hybrid hardware/subscription environment with complex supply chain dynamics strongly preferred.
  • Strong command of three-statement financial modeling and the accounting mechanics underlying the cash flow statement and balance sheet, including revenue recognition and the cash implications of legal entity and intercompany structures.
  • Exceptional financial modeling skills, with experience building transparent, auditable, driver-based models designed for scenario and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience building new finance capabilities, processes, or teams and leading and developing finance professionals.
  • Experience partnering across Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Supply Chain, Operations, Investor Relations, and FP&A to drive complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Ability to translate complex financial and operational dynamics into clear, decision-ready insights for executive leadership and Board-level audiences.
  • Experience working with large, imperfect data sets and identifying the drivers and trends that matter most for business decision-making.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience using enterprise planning platforms such as Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive, or similar and ERP systems such as NetSuite or SAP.
  • Familiarity with modern finance data and analytics tools, including SQL, BI platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, and data warehouses.
  • BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; MBA, CPA, or CFA is a plus.
  • Experience with public-company free cash flow guidance, supply chain finance, treasury, operations finance, or centralized procurement structures is a plus.

title: Senior Collections Analyst
descriptionHtml:

THE ROLE As a Senior Collections Analyst at Everpure, you will spearhead global cash optimization and serve as the lead functional authority across our order-to-cash systems. You will champion financial predictability by resolving multifaceted account portfolios, balancing commercial deal acceleration against credit risk, and eliminating systemic dispute drivers. Partnering closely with Sales, Billing, and Finance leadership, you will elevate receivables performance and drive enterprise-scale process enhancements that safeguard revenue.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and optimize collections strategy across high-value global commercial portfolios to accelerate cash flow, mitigate bad-debt exposure, and secure timely payment commitments.

  • Serve as the primary functional advisor on ERP processes and credit hold governance, partnering with Sales leadership to balance urgent quarter-end deal execution against risk mitigation.

  • Orchestrate resolution of complex, cross-functional billing disputes and deduction issues in collaboration with Sales, Billing, Customer Experience, and Legal teams to protect customer relationships and revenue integrity.

  • Steer international collections compliance and tax coordination across multiple jurisdictions, navigating withholding tax documentation and country-specific regulatory requirements.

Portfolio & Collections Management

  • Own and manage a large, global portfolio of commercial accounts driving proactive daily/weekly outreach to secure payment commitments (PTPs) and reduce past-due balances.

  • Track and log all collections activity, payment receipts, and partner communications in a structured account-level format to maintain a clear audit trail and hand-off continuity.

  • Prioritize outreach and escalation based on aging buckets (current, 30-60, 60-90, 90+) and account risk/exposure size.

Order Hold & Release Decisioning

  • Act as an advisor for the credit hold team on payment history to support the team to determine order hold/release status, including managing "hard hold" accounts requiring senior-level sign-off.

  • Balance commercial urgency (pending sales orders, quarter-end deals) against credit hold when authorizing exceptions or partial releases taking into consideration customer history or promise to pay.

Dispute & Deduction Resolution

  • Investigate and resolve billing disputes, credit memo requests, short payments, and skipped invoices in partnership with Sales, Billing, Credit, and Customer Experience (CX) teams.

  • Drive resolution of complex multi-party disputes (e.g., contested invoice amounts, debooking requests, governance/credit approval letters) requiring documented sign-off from Sales leadership before action.

  • Liaise with Legal on formal escalations, including demand letters and late-payment penalty enforcement for chronically delinquent or terminated accounts.

International Collections & Tax Compliance

  • Manage withholding tax (WHT) reconciliation and documentation across multiple countries, partnering with Tax/CM teams on certificate requirements and treatment of WHT balances in aging.

  • Navigate country-specific payment cycles, entity name changes, and local regulatory requirements that affect collections timing and reporting.

Escalation & Risk Management

  • Identify high-risk, chronically past-due, or terminated-reseller accounts and escalate to sales leadership, credit, and legal as needed, including recommending accounts for demand letters or legal action.

  • Flag accounts for bad debt reserve review based on payment deterioration, disputed balances, or customer/reseller instability.

descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. THE ROLE
NAND is one of Everpure's most expensive and most constrained inputs, and how it gets allocated across the Contract Manufacturing network determines what actually gets built and shipped. This role owns that decision: translating supplier allocations into executable CM supply plans, deciding where limited supply goes when it can't cover everything, and keeping those calls consistent and defensible across products, customers, and sites. It sits at the intersection of Commodity, Demand Planning, Finance, suppliers, and the CMs — the single point where component availability, production commitments, and financial exposure get reconciled. When supply tightens, this is the person the business relies on for a clear recommendation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the end-to-end NAND supply-demand plan and allocation across the CM network, turning supplier allocations into buildable plans and making the trade-off calls when supply is constrained — with a consistent, auditable basis across products, customers, and sites.
  • Run NAND PO execution (quantity, part number, pricing, delivery timing, open PO status) and hold an accurate picture of consumption, inventory, WIP, and finished goods across CM sites, validating what CMs report rather than taking it at face value.
  • Set and monitor safety stock and min/max levels across sites, identify shortages and supply risks early, and bring mitigation plans and escalations with a recommendation attached, not just a flag.
  • Partner with Finance on NAND pricing, cost variance, inventory aging, and working capital exposure so financial risk is visible before it materializes.
  • Serve as the primary NAND supply interface across Commodity, Demand Planning, Finance, suppliers, and CMs, and give management and S&OP the allocation, PO, and inventory reporting they plan against.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Depth in supply or material planning for constrained components — enough time operating in shortage conditions to have developed real judgment about allocation trade-offs and where the downstream consequences land.
  • Hands-on experience planning through Contract Manufacturers, and working knowledge of semiconductor or electronics component supply.
  • Fluency with supply and inventory data in ERP/MRP systems and in Excel or comparable analytics tools, including the ability to spot when reported inventory and consumption numbers don't reconcile.
  • The ability to hold a clear position and drive a decision across Commodity, Finance, Demand Planning, suppliers, and CMs when priorities compete and there's no clean answer.
