title: Senior Manager - Data & Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on leader to own the data, analytics, and AI portfolio end to end — and the team that builds it. You are the single point of accountability between business stakeholders and the analytics organization: gathering and pressure-testing requirements, turning ambiguous problems into a prioritized roadmap, and leading the developers, analysts, and data scientists who deliver scalable, trusted, widely adopted products. This is not a role that manages from a distance. You will be in the requirements sessions, the data model reviews, the SQL, the dashboard design critiques, and the model evaluations — and you will be measured on adoption and business outcomes, not backlog size or model sophistication.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Team Leadership & Talent
● Lead the team. Manage a talented team of senior and junior developers, analysts, and data scientists — setting direction on best practices, engineering standards, and alignment with team priorities.
● Develop people. Mentor team members, connecting their personal and professional goals to real career growth; set the standard for rigor and craft.
Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements
● Be the trusted partner. Serve as the primary interface to the different organizations and run structured discovery to elicit underlying needs, not feature requests.
● Write requirements that hold up. Translate business questions into testable specs: source systems, grain, metric definitions,  SLAs, quality thresholds, and acceptance criteria. Drive a single source of truth for core metrics and arbitrate definitional conflicts.
● Simplify the complex. Navigate ambiguous, politically loaded problems and distill them into actionable messaging that aligns with business priorities and lands with executives. Prioritization, 

Roadmap & Datamart Strategy
● Own the roadmap. Manage, prioritize, and align data, reporting, and analytics requirements with business needs, overseeing development and implementation.
● Make trade-offs explicit. Apply a consistent prioritization framework — value, reach, effort, risk, strategic fit — and communicate the rationale transparently, including to stakeholders you deprioritize.
● Shape strategy at the table. Play a key role in cross-functional committees defining data mart strategy, governance, and policy; invest ahead of demand in capabilities that make future requests cheaper to serve. 

Visualization & Experience Design
● Design for the decision. Set the standard for how analytics is presented — choose the right visual for the question, build a clear hierarchy, and design every dashboard around the decision the user is trying to make rather than the data that happens to be available.
● Own the design system. Define and enforce visualization standards across the portfolio — chart conventions, color, typography, layout, naming, interaction patterns, and accessibility — so products look and behave consistently and stay maintainable as the team grows.
● Prototype, test, and prune. Wireframe and iterate with real users before building; validate with usage data and feedback, and retire dashboards that don't drive action.

Technical Leadership: Warehouse, BI & Pipelines
● Lead technically. Hands-on in advanced SQL on Snowflake, with the credibility to review the team's work rather than take it on faith.
● Design for scale. Oversee scalable pipelines and workflows that process large, diverse, unstructured datasets with high performance and reliability; automate cleaning, integration, and analysis in SQL and Python.
● Enable self-service. Champion governed datasets, semantic layers, and intuitive dashboards that let non-technical users answer their own questions — over one-off extracts and bespoke reports.
● Optimize what exists. Drive innovation in data architecture, dashboard performance, and cost efficiency; champion data quality and accuracy through lineage, testing, and clear ownership.

Data Science, AI & Machine Learning
● Set the AI agenda. Identify, size, and prioritize the use cases where ML and generative AI create real business value — and say no to the ones that don't.
● Deliver GenAI experiences. Build generative AI into the analytics stack — natural-language querying, conversational BI, automated insight generation, AI-assisted documentation and discovery.

Adoption, Measurement & Communication
● Measure what matters. Define success metrics for every product — adoption, time-to-insight, data freshness, decisions enabled, cost — and hold the team accountable to them.
● Drive adoption and clarity. Lead enablement through documentation, training, and change management; present insights, risks, and trade-offs to audiences from individual engineers to the executive staff.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bengaluru office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience & Leadership
● 15+ years in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or data platform roles, including 4+ years directly managing teams. An advanced degree in statistics, data science, or computer science preferred.
● Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise data, BI, or analytics portfolio from requirements through production adoption, with evidence of business impact — plus a track record of solving complex problems and using data to influence senior stakeholders.
● Domain expertise in one or more of: finance, customer, or product. Experience with CRM and ERP datasets strongly preferred.

Technical Depth
● Advanced SQL — able to write, review, optimize, and debug complex analytical queries independently; deep experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
● Knowledge of Python, including package development and production-quality code standards.
● Hands-on with enterprise BI and semantic layer tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, ThoughtSpot) and what makes them perform at scale; working knowledge of governance, lineage, observability, and access control.

Visualization & Design
● Strong data visualization craft — fluent in chart selection, visual hierarchy, and the principles that separate a clear view from a cluttered one. Able to take a dense, ambiguous dataset and present it so an executive understands it in seconds.
● Genuine design sensibility: layout, whitespace, typography, purposeful color, and accessibility (including colorblind-safe palettes). A portfolio of dashboards or reports you designed is welcome.
● Experience establishing visualization standards or a design system across a BI portfolio, and comfort wireframing and iterating with users. Familiarity with UX principles and design tools such as Figma is a plus.

Business & Communication Skill
● Sophisticated stakeholder management: build consensus across functions, hold a position under pressure, and say no without damaging the relationship.
● Connect data and AI investments to business outcomes and articulate ROI in the language of the function being served.
Excellent written and verbal communication — equally capable of a one-page decision memo and an executive presentation.

title: Japan CX Director
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Japan CX Director 　* New Position

Customer Experience (CX) Strategic Leadership, Everpure 

Role Summary 

The Japan Service Director is a senior CX leader accountable for long-term value creation with Everpure's most strategic Japanese enterprise customers. The core mission is to be a trusted advisor to these customers, producing mutual innovation and measurable outcomes. This leader owns the Japan CX strategy, including the 3-year plan and customer success motion, and represents Everpure at the executive level in Japan, including major escalations. 

The role is a matrix lead across customer-dedicated team members and works with global CX, Sales, Engineering and partner organizations. It covers the full CX framework: Technical Support (TS), Professional Services (PS), Advanced Services, PEAK, Customer Advocacy, Portfolio, and Customer Success.

What You Will Be Doing 

Drive strategic customer outcomes in Japan 

  • Deliver a world-class service experience that exceeds Japanese customer expectations, including expectations around quality, responsiveness and proactive communication. 
  • Own the Japan CX strategy and 3-year plan, including the customer success motion and plan, in partnership with global CX and portfolio leaders. 
  • Partner with Sales to execute 1–3-year integrated account plans. Join account planning meetings for top customers and other strategic accounts as required, and act as the single point of accountability for the Japan customer experience across the full services portfolio. 
  • Maintain a deep, face-to-face presence with named customers, building trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and executives. 
  • Partner with the cross-functional delivery team (SAM, DSE, TAM, CSM and Channel Partners) as a peer of the other team leaders, aligning efforts across functions to deliver consistent, high-quality service to Japanese customers.
  • Partner with the designated executive sponsor(s) to achieve their objectives and outcomes for Japan accounts. 
  • Develop and implement customer retention strategies for the Japan market. 

Escalations and customer advocacy 

  • Represent Everpure at major Japanese escalations, working with the service support team and functional owners through critical care programs, with proactive communication and executive involvement for swift resolution. 
  • Champion Japanese customer requirements into Engineering, Quality, product roadmaps and service offer development. 
  • Advocate for and influence Japan-specific processes and workflows (Lifecycle Services or Business Critical Services) so that global processes meet local expectations. 
  • Advocate for EG1(Evergreen1) customers and services, applying strong financial acumen. 
  • Sponsor Continuous Improvement and Problem Management trends for Japan accounts, driving swift root cause analysis and remediation. 

Customer journey, growth and innovation 

  • Design and plan the service customer journey (Lifecycle Management) for Japan accounts. 
  • Understand each customer's core business goals with Sales, and identify opportunities for value co-creation, growth, and expansion.
  • Drive account-based innovation to improve customer perception of solution and service value, ease of doing business, and continuous improvement. 
  • Collaborate with the Executive Sponsor, Sales and service team members on a customer relationship roadmap that guides future service and technology investment. 
  • Create and own a cadence of forward-looking, service-focused strategy sessions with Japan accounts. 
  • Work with Sales on service cross-sell and up-sell, with a focus on retention, diversification and growth. 
  • Build referenceable customers across the services portfolio. 
  • Coordinate AI-related initiatives and customer engagement for Japan. 
  • Support readiness for new products and portfolio areas, such as Portworx (ASP/PX, Data Intelligence, and Data Stream), through proactive, end-to-end CX planning. 

Service partner (ASP) oversight 

  • Hold local ownership of the Authorized Service Partner (ASP) relationship in Japan at an executive-influence level, acting as program manager rather than owner of the partners' business. 
  • Oversee the quality of outsourced partners and ASPs, as the first priority of this function. 
  • Help grow the ASP network in Japan. This is a corporate goal rather than an individual KPI, and the focus is service and support partners, not product-selling partners. 
  • Work to clarify and standardize the ASP model, which is currently vague and varied across the market. 

Localization and communication 

  • Lead project participation and ownership for Japan initiatives as needed. 
  • Ensure translation and localization of key materials, reporting and processes for local consumption. 
  • Ensure consistent communication and reporting across all service functions for Japan Global Strategic Accounts (for example, standard QBR templates adapted for Japanese customers). 
  • Communicate the Japan service vision, strategy and plan to Executive, Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, IT and CX leadership teams, and build a company-wide culture of customer-centricity. 

Measure the effectiveness of strategic account management 

  • Own Global Strategic Account Program KPIs for Japan accounts, including loyalty, satisfaction, diversification of spend and relationship equity. 
  • Build and maintain a Japan scorecard and success index against which role effectiveness is measured. 
  • Maintain "World Class" CSAT and NPS for assigned accounts. 
  • Report critical success factors and performance to senior leadership and share best practices across Global Strategic Accounts. 
  • Build a Voice of the Customer program for Japan that aligns with the Global Customer Advisory Board. 
  • Evangelizing New Services to customers.

What You Bring 

Required 

  • Bachelor's degree in business, IT, Computer Science or equivalent field. 
  • 10+ years of experience managing global enterprise accounts, large multinational service engagements, or equivalent. 
  • Proven customer-facing, executive-level account leadership, with demonstrated experience with Japanese enterprise customers and an understanding of Japanese business practices and customer expectations. 
  • Native in Japanese is required 
  • Business Proficiency level or higher in English, spoken and written, including the ability to present to executives and write at a professional level in both languages. 
  • Ability to influence persuasion, negotiation and consensus building, including across a matrix and with partners where influence matters more than ownership. 
  • Strong business and financial acumen, and a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue models. 
  • Ability to lead and develop large, multifaceted teams. 
  • Solid analytical skills and a process-oriented mindset, with composure in the face of customer escalations. 
  • Excellent presentation skills and comfort sharing thought leadership with executives from Everpure, customers and partners. 
  • Strong written skills and competence with business tools for documents, financial analysis, and presentations. 
  • Experience working in a matrix environment. 
  • Willingness to travel within Japan, and occasionally abroad, to meet customers and partners. 

Nice to have 

  • ITIL Foundation certification or comparable certification. 
  • Master's degree in business or related field. 
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in the data storage industry. 
  • Experience managing or overseeing service partners or channel/ASP programs. 

Japan CX Director　＊新設ポジション

ポジション概要

AI・データ活用が経営の中核になる時代に、日本を代表するエンタープライズのお客様のデータ基盤を支え、共に成果を創り出す。それがジャパン CXディレクターのミッションです。

Everpureの日本における最重要顧客に対し、長期的な価値創出を担う CX(カスタマーエクスペリエンス)部門のシニアリーダーです。お客様の「信頼されるアドバイザー」として、測定可能な成果と共創によるイノベーションを実現します。

  • 日本の CX 戦略および3カ年計画、カスタマーサクセスの取り組みを策定・推進
  • 日本における Everpure の経営層レベルの顔として、重大なエスカレーションにも対応
  • お客様専任チームを横断的にリードし(マトリクス型)、グローバル CX、営業、エンジニアリング、パートナーと連携
  • 対象領域は CX フレームワーク全体:テクニカルサポート(TS)、プロフェッショナルサービス(PS)、アドバンストサービス、PEAK、カスタマーアドボカシー、ポートフォリオ、カスタマーサクセス

このポジションの魅力

  • AI 時代の中核を担う:生成 AI やデータ活用の本格展開で重要性が増すデータ基盤とデータ管理サービスを、日本の最重要顧客と共に推進できます
  • 経営層と向き合う:お客様のエグゼクティブと対面で信頼関係を築き、日本における Everpure の顔として経営レベルの意思決定に関わります
  • 日本の声をグローバルへ:日本のお客様の要件を製品ロードマップやサービス開発に反映し、グローバルのプロセスを日本の期待に合わせて進化させられます
  • 戦略を自ら描く:日本の CX 戦略と3カ年計画をオーナーとして策定。新製品・新サービス(Portworx など)の立ち上げにも早期から関われます
  • グローバルとローカルの架け橋:グローバル CX、営業、エンジニアリング、パートナーと連携し、日英両言語で活躍できます

業務内容

1. 日本のお客様の戦略的成果をリードする

  • 品質・レスポンス・先回りのコミュニケーションなど、日本のお客様の高い期待を超える世界水準のサービス体験を提供
  • グローバル CX・ポートフォリオ部門と連携し、日本の CX 戦略と3カ年計画(カスタマーサクセスの施策を含む)を策定
  • 営業と共に1〜3年の統合アカウントプランを推進。トップ顧客や戦略アカウントのプランニング会議に参画し、サービス全体における日本の顧客体験の「単一の責任窓口」を担う
  • 指定顧客のキーパーソン・経営層と対面での深い信頼関係を構築
  • お客様専任の担当者(SAM、DSE、TAM、CSM、チャネルパートナー)と部署の垣根を越えて協力し、日本のお客様に一貫して高品質なサービスを届けるチームづくりを推進する(メンバーは別部門に所属しており、他部門のリーダーと対等の立場で協力・連携・調整する)
  • エグゼクティブスポンサーと連携し、日本アカウントの目標と成果の達成を支援
  • 日本市場向けのリテンション戦略を立案・実行

2. エスカレーション対応とお客様の声の反映

  • 重大なエスカレーションにおいて Everpure を代表し、サポート部門や関係部署とクリティカルケア・プログラムを推進。プロアクティブな情報共有と経営層の関与により、迅速な解決を実現
  • 日本のお客様の要望をエンジニアリング、品質部門、製品ロードマップ、サービス開発へ橋渡し
  • ライフサイクルサービスやビジネスクリティカルサービスなど、グローバルのプロセスが日本の期待に合致するよう働きかけ
  • Evergreen//One(EG1)のお客様とサービスを推進し、財務面の洞察を発揮
  • 継続的改善と問題管理のトレンドをスポンサーし、迅速な根本原因分析と是正を主導

3. お客様との関係づくり、事業成長、イノベーション:AI・データ時代の共創

  • 導入から運用、更新、拡張まで、お客様がサービスを利用する全期間の流れ(ライフサイクルマネジメント)を日本向けに設計・計画
  • 営業と共にお客様の事業目標を深く理解し、価値共創・成長・拡大の機会を特定
  • アカウント単位のイノベーションを推進し、ソリューションとサービスの価値、取引のしやすさ、継続的改善に対する顧客評価を向上
  • エグゼクティブスポンサー、営業、サービスチームと、今後のサービス・技術投資の指針となる顧客リレーションシップ・ロードマップを策定

  • サービスポートフォリオ全体でリファレンス可能なお客様を創出
  • 日本における AI 関連の取り組みとお客様エンゲージメントを統括:生成 AI や機械学習の本番活用を見据えたデータ基盤の価値を、お客様と共に具体化
  • データ管理領域の新製品・新サービスの立ち上げを支援:Portworx(ASP/PX、Data Intelligence、Data Stream)など、エンドツーエンドの CX 計画を先行して策定

4. サービスパートナー(ASP)の統括

  • 日本の認定サービスパートナー(ASP)との関係を、経営層への影響力を持つ立場で統括(パートナー事業のオーナーではなく、プログラムマネージャーとして)
  • 委託先パートナー・ASP のサービス品質の監督を最優先事項として担当
  • 日本の ASP ネットワークの拡大を支援(個人 KPI ではなく全社目標。対象は製品販売ではなく、サービス・サポートを担うパートナー)
  • 現在は市場ごとに多様で不明瞭な ASP モデルの明確化と標準化を推進

5. ローカライズとコミュニケーション

  • 日本向けの取り組みにおけるプロジェクトの参画・オーナーシップを担当
  • 主要資料、レポート、プロセスの翻訳・ローカライズを推進
  • 日本のグローバル戦略アカウントに対するサービス全体の一貫したコミュニケーションとレポーティング(例:日本のお客様向けに調整した QBR テンプレート)を確保
  • 日本のサービスビジョン・戦略・計画を、経営、製品、営業、マーケティング、財務、IT、CX の各リーダーシップに発信し、全社的な顧客中心の文化を醸成

6. 戦略アカウント・マネジメントの成果測定

  • 日本アカウントにおけるグローバル戦略アカウント・プログラムの KPI(ロイヤルティ、満足度、支出の多様化、リレーションシップ・エクイティ)を管理
  • 日本のスコアカードと成功指標を構築・運用し、本ポジションの成果を測定
  • 担当アカウントで「ワールドクラス」の CSAT と NPS を維持
  • 重要成功要因と実績をシニアリーダーシップに報告し、グローバル戦略アカウント間でベストプラクティスを共有
  • グローバル・カスタマー・アドバイザリー・ボードと連動した、日本の Voice of the Customer プログラムを構築
  • 新サービスをお客様へ積極的に紹介

応募資格(必須)

  • 大学卒業(ビジネス、IT、コンピュータサイエンス、またはそれに準ずる分野)
  • 10年以上のグローバルエンタープライズ顧客のアカウント管理、または大規模なマルチナショナル・サービス案件の管理経験 
  • 日本の大手企業のお客様に対する、経営層レベルでのアカウントリーダーシップの実績。日本のビジネス慣行とお客様の期待への深い理解

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力(会話・文書)。経営層へのプレゼンテーションと、日英両言語でのプロフェッショナルな文書作成が可能なこと

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Security Operations Engineer – Attack Surface Management, you will help engineer, operate, and continuously improve our enterprise Attack Surface and Vulnerability Management capabilities.

You will focus on discovering and understanding our attack surface, identifying vulnerabilities and exposures, prioritizing them based on real-world risk, and driving remediation across our global environment.

The role spans Attack Surface Management, Vulnerability Management, Zero Trust, Secrets and Credential Security, SSPM, Deception, Detection Engineering and Security Automation. We are looking for engineers with strong ASM/Vulnerability Management fundamentals and deeper expertise in one or more adjacent security domains.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Engineer and improve enterprise Attack Surface and Vulnerability Management across cloud, infrastructure, endpoints, applications, and internet-facing environments.
  • Discover and correlate assets across security platforms and identify unknown, unmanaged, stale, and externally exposed assets.
  • Drive risk-based vulnerability prioritization using asset criticality, exposure, exploitability, known exploitation, threat intelligence, and compensating controls.
  • Establish remediation workflows and SLAs and partner with asset owners to drive measurable risk reduction.
  • Operate and troubleshoot Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, including SSL inspection, access policies, connectivity, and Zero Trust controls.
  • Discover and investigate exposed secrets and credentials across source code, CI/CD, cloud, repositories, and enterprise platforms, and coordinate remediation and credential rotation.
  • Develop and improve SIEM detections to identify exploitation, anomalous activity, credential abuse, and attack-surface-related threats.
  • Support threat hunting and incident investigations using vulnerability, asset, endpoint, and threat intelligence context.
  • Develop automation using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, and SOAR for asset enrichment, vulnerability triage, remediation tracking, integrations, and reporting.
  • Partner with Cloud, Infrastructure, Network, Product Security, and Engineering teams to investigate exposures and drive remediation.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable risk guidance and reporting for technical teams and leadership.
  • Support security governance and compliance requirements including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, with hands-on experience in Security Operations, Attack Surface Management, Vulnerability Management, or Exposure Management.
  • Strong understanding of asset discovery, vulnerability lifecycle, risk-based prioritization, remediation, and validation.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or similar technologies.
  • Strong security fundamentals across TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, operating systems, identity, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience automating security workflows using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex security problems.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to drive remediation.

About The Role

The Lifecycle Account Manager (LAM) is a strategic, revenue-aligned post-sales role sitting within the Lifecycle Revenue Organization. Partnering closely with Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Engineers (SEs), the LAM owns telemetry-driven account oversight, business value realization, and capacity activation across a dedicated portfolio of customer accounts.

This is a commercially accountable role: success is measured not by satisfaction scores alone, but by hard consumption and revenue outcomes — utilization, retention, and expansion.

Core Objectives

  • Drive Capacity & Adoption — Eliminate idle or "dark" capacity by driving use-case adoption and workload expansion.
  • Protect Retention (GRR) — Deliver measurable Business Value Outcomes (BVOs) that secure renewals and protect Gross Revenue Retention.
  • Expand Revenue (NRR) — Accelerate Net Revenue Retention by transitioning customers onto continuous platform subscription models (e.g., Evergreen//One, EDC, Portworx).

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive Oversight — Analyze Pure1 telemetry to identify accounts with stagnant capacity utilization.
  • Early Risk Triage — Lead intervention for target account cohorts from T-180 through T-12 to preemptively mitigate churn and down-sell risk.
  • Account Intelligence — Synthesize input across CS, PS, AE, and SE teams to assess stakeholder sentiment, account history, and overall engagement health.
  • Value Mapping — Facilitate post-sale Business Value Outcome (BVO) workshops to align client goals with unallocated capacity.
  • Impact Tracking — Establish baseline metrics (B₀) and run regular check-ins to demonstrate performance, efficiency, and ROI against original sales promises.
  • Strategic Roadmapping — Partner with account teams to deliver EDC Blueprint workshops and actionable adoption roadmaps.
  • Activation Playbooks — Execute structured Capacity Activation playbooks to guide clients in migrating secondary workloads into idle headroom.
  • Professional Services Alignment — Collaborate with Advanced Services to scope and position projects that ensure seamless migration.
  • Pipeline Generation — Leverage hardware utilization insights to surface expansion opportunities and deliver qualified leads to AEs.
  • Subscription Migration — Partner with AEs to convert CapEx hardware refresh cycles into predictable subscription ARR.
  • Strategic Collaboration — Work in lockstep with AEs (commercial lead) and SEs (technical lead), while maintaining clear operational boundaries with CS (satisfaction) and Product teams.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: 5–8+ years in Customer Success Management, Value Engineering, Technical Account Management, or Commercial Account Management within enterprise SaaS, IT infrastructure, or cloud environments.
  • Scale: Track record leading demanding accounts with $10M+ revenue, building relationships from C-level executives down to directors, managers, and practitioners.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong grasp of cloud-consumption economics (ARR, NRR, GRR, CapEx-to-OpEx transitions), with familiarity in enterprise storage, data management, or infrastructure technologies.
  • Commercial & Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to identify expansion opportunities, defend renewals, and drive value-realization motions.
  • Data-Driven & Analytical: Comfortable using product telemetry, analytics tools, and CRM systems to spot risk and uncover expansion signals.
  • Communication & Facilitation: Executive presence, with demonstrated ability to lead customer workshops, present value reports to C-level stakeholders, and manage cross-functional sales/SE teams.

Core Capabilities & Competencies

  • Value Realization Expertise — Translates complex technical metrics into quantifiable business value outcomes for customer executives.
  • Proactive Risk Triage — Reads telemetry signals, anticipates renewal friction, and intervenes early.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration — Drives alignment across AE, SE, Professional Services, and Customer Success stakeholders.

Partner with product and infrastructure teams to find issues earlier in the pipeline, improve signal quality, and reduce manual toil in triage and merge operations.
  • SDLC Optimization: Continuously improve the SDLC by identifying bottlenecks in the build-test-deploy loop and implementing automated gates.
  • Stakeholder Management: Communicate release status, risks, and trade-offs to executive leadership, ensuring transparency across the organization.
  • Fleet Management: Improve the health, automation, and operational efficiency of HW test fleets that support CI and merge workflows.
  • Operation support: Participate in on-call duty rotations for CI and test-orchestration infrastructure; lead incident triage and mitigation, bring order to chaos, and ensure thorough follow-through on root-cause fixes.
  • Automation: Build easy-to-use tools that help developers diagnose failures in test and infrastructure systems. Own and improve automation, workflows, and quality gates around git collaboration and code integration across FA and FB codelines.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 4+ years hands-on experience leading or executing threat hunts, incident investigations, or detection engineering in a SOC or SIEM environment
  • Deep hands-on experience with Splunk (search, dashboards, alerts, correlation searches, saved searches, deployment server, forwarder management)
  • Strong understanding of the incident response lifecycle: triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident learning
  • Solid grasp of networking, systems, cloud, and security architecture (identity, endpoint, network, cloud)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Automation & SOAR: Hands-on experience with Tines, XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent platforms for API-driven orchestration and response.

  • Container & Kubernetes security: Falco, eBPF-based detection, container runtime monitoring, supply chain security (image scanning, vulnerability management)
  • Agentic & AI workflows: Experience evaluating or implementing LLM-assisted triage and AI-generated detections with strong human oversight.
  • Threat intelligence: Understanding of Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs) and operationalizing CTI into detection pipelines.
  • Scripting & IaC: Proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go; exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).

You will design and run multi‑week, customer‑like scenarios that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions.

This is a hands‑on, high‑impact role at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‑scale testing—acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure’s customers.

Everpure Cloud Azure Native is a generally available service that brings enterprise-grade block storage natively to Azure. With the first version already live, we are expanding the service into new use cases and markets while improving its reliability, operability, and customer experience.

Our Foundation team owns a Go-based control-plane service that coordinates how customers provision and use storage in Azure. Around it, we work with a modern cloud stack including Temporal and other platform services for workflows, automation, and observability. This is a production cloud service: the code you write directly shapes how customers deploy, scale, and operate storage in their Azure environments.

You’ll work on a core storage service in a major public cloud, as part of a joint effort between Everpure and Microsoft. You’ll design and evolve APIs and service behavior in the critical path of real customer workloads, collaborating closely with engineers across both companies.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. THE ROLE

Team lead for a group of engineers with responsibility for Linux and VMWare initiator stack behavior as well as Fibre Channel and NIC drivers on Pure storage array.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Kernel and Driver development team is responsible for several areas

  • Working for a team that deals primarily in various storage area network protocols such as Fiber Channel and Ethernet. 
  • On the initiator side, the team will be responsible for Linux initiator behavior attached to Flasharray. Focus is on NVME (ROCE, FC, TCP/IP) but also includes FC-SCSI (FCP) and iSCSI interfaces. This includes software development/fixes for Linux initiator stack, debugging initiator problems, and creating compatibility documents for Purity. For VMWare, focus is on debugging issues with VMWare as an initiator, and creating compatibility documentation.
  • For FibreChannel and NIC Drivers, focus is responsibility for FC-SCSI driver stack for storage side and responsibility for NIC drivers on networking side. This includes responsibility for related code, utilities, enhancements supporting RAS, as well as debugging failures found internally and in the field.
  • Maintain Linux kernels for internal testing
  • Documenting supported configurations for customers
  • Responsibility for evaluating Linux initiator behavior and optimizing for Pure Storage Flasharray. This includes correctness as well as optimizing for performances. Will contribute bug fixes and enhancements to Linux upstream. Analyze and debug difficult Linux bugs to optimize Flasharray attachment.
  • Responsible for maintaining Purity’s Fibre Channel SCSI (FCP) target driver. Maintenance includes driver updates for enhancements, bugs fixes and new hardware.
  • Resolve difficult Fibre Channel bugs found internally or externally and enhancing the resilience of Pure’s FC stack. This includes projects around multipathing and link health.
  • Responsible for maintaining NIC drivers on Pure’s storage systems. 
  • Dealing with middle ware C++ modules

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong experience writing device drivers and/or kernel development for Linux/Unix. Prefer experience in storage and/or networking drivers
  • Minimum 3 years of development experience, but expect that typically candidates would have 8+ years experience. 
  • Experience designing and implementing significant components in storage protocol stacks and storage systems. 
  • Experience with storage protocols: either SCSI (FC-SCSI or iSCSI/FCP) and/or NVME Fabrics (NVME/ROCE, NVME/TCP or NVME/FC)  will be an advantage.
  • Experience leading other engineers technically. Should be able to mentor more junior engineers and lead other engineers in an overall project.  Should demonstrate on time delivery with high quality.
  • Experience with performance analysis/optimization for storage systems or protocols
  • Should have VMWare experience, with understanding of their initiator stack. 
  • Experience writing Linux storage device drivers, including some sets of Fibre Channel, NVME, ROCE, block and multipath modules.
  • Experience debugging difficult storage attach issues.
  • Experience with software development using C and C++, along with Python
  • Experience upstreaming Linux code is preferred
  • Should have experience developing test automation
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing storage performance

title: Senior Solutions Architect, MSP
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE:

Everpure is building the Enterprise Data Cloud - data unified, governed and understood as one intelligent system, and the foundation enterprises build AI on. Managed service providers are one of the most direct routes to that outcome at scale: they own the customer relationship, they operate the platform, and every workload they land compounds. Data Intelligence, cyber resilience, Portworx and Evergreen//One turns Everpure from a component in an MSP’s stack into the substrate their service is built on.

We are rebooting our approach. Everpure is standing up a global practice dedicated to MSPs and building a new MSP program behind it. The Senior Solutions Architect, MSP is the technical front line of that practice; the person in the room with the MSP’s architects and their end customers, winning the deals that prove the model works.

This is a field-facing, deal-led role. You will carry technical responsibility for MSP opportunities end to end, from early shaping through to close, and you will do it across the full Everpure platform. Managed service deals are won on unit economics as much as architecture, so you will be as fluent in cost per tenant as you are in a whiteboard session.

The practice is being built around you, and what you learn in live deals is what shapes it. But your primary measure is pipeline and bookings won with MSP partners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Own technical leadership of MSP opportunities end to end: discovery, solution design, sizing, competitive positioning, POCs and technical close.

  • Engage early to shape the platform the managed service will be built on.
  • Drive strategic deals in existing MSP accounts, and open whitespace MSPs in your region.
  • Support the MSP’s own sales cycles with their end customers, co-selling live rather than briefing from the sidelines.

Design the service, not just the solution

  • Define the end-to-end architecture including multi-tenancy, automation, provisioning, operational model and integration into the MSP’s existing service stack.
  • Model and influence the commercial construct: managed service unit economics, cost per tenant, TB and workload, Evergreen//One and consumption models, and the margin story that makes Everpure the right substrate.
  • Design for the way MSPs actually operate; API-led, automated, billable. MSPs do not buy what they cannot automate.

Win the competitive battles

  • Displace the competitors in MSP environments.
  • Position and win across the full platform,  FlashArray, FlashBlade, Portworx and Everpure Data Intelligence, not a single product line.
  • Build and use the competitive evidence base: battle cards, teardowns, reference wins and proof points that stand up in the MSP’s own sales conversation.

Build technical credibility with the partner

  • Establish yourself as the trusted technical voice with MSP architects, practice leads and CTOs.
  • Enable MSP technical teams to design and sell autonomously, so every deal you support builds capability for the ten you are not in.
  • Grow a population of partner-side technical champions who can carry Everpure without you in the room.

Feed the practice and the program

  • Bring real MSP requirements back into the new global MSP program and Product Management — multi-tenancy, licensing, billing integration, API and automation gaps.
  • Contribute reusable IP from live engagements: reference architectures, sizing and scaling guides, service blueprints.

Work across Everpure

  • Escalate and orchestrate specialist support cleanly rather than carrying every technical ask personally.
  • Represent Everpure at partner-facing events, roadshows, webinars and technical workshops, and create technical content that reaches the wider MSP community.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 5+ years in pre-sales, solutions architecture or technical leadership, with a demonstrable record of winning partner-led business.
  • Direct experience with MSPs, and a real understanding of how they build, price, operate and sell a managed service.
  • Commercial fluency. Comfortable discussing consumption economics, TCO and margin with an MSP’s finance and practice leadership.
  • Track record of driving and closing technically complex deals in a competitive environment.
  • Credible at depth across modern data platform architecture: block, file and object, unstructured data at scale, hybrid and cloud data services, Kubernetes and storage-as-a-service models.
  • Strong working knowledge of compute, database, networking and virtualization, plus emerging areas including AI/ML data pipelines and data governance and classification.
  • Fluent in cyber resilience, virtualization migration dynamics and the competitive landscape.
  • Practical command of multi-tenancy, automation and API-driven infrastructure.
  • Product experience across technology vendors within the relevant region.
  • Outstanding written, diagrammatic and verbal communication, with the ability to reduce complex ideas to simple terms for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Executive presence to move between an MSP CTO conversation and a whiteboard architecture session.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across the broader Everpure organization and to influence without authority.
  • Entrepreneurial and ambitious. This is a practice being built, not one being inherited.
  • Combines a big-thinking strategic perspective with a detail-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Thrives in ambiguity and pace, prioritizes ruthlessly, and drives for results with a strong sense of accountability.

Our mission? Deliver a simple, evergreen data platform that enables everyone to turn data into intelligence and advantage. The secret sauce? More than 3,000 team members (and growing!) around the world who join forces to invent the next big thing. And then the next one.

Our customers are the most important part of our business and they love FlashArray for it's simplicity of management, the constant flow of new and exciting upgrades, and ability to live on the cutting edge of technology while never taking downtime, ever.   • Validation & Automation Capability: Proven ability to design, automate, and execute hardware qualification frameworks using scripting languages (such as Python or BASH) alongside industry-standard stress and diagnostic tools.

  • Root-Cause & Signal Analysis: Hands-on proficiency analyzing device- and system-level power regulators, cooling, and high-speed signal integrity utilizing oscilloscopes and protocol analyzers.

  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Demonstrated success leading technical projects autonomously in fast-paced environments, collaborating across engineering and manufacturing disciplines, and mentoring team members.

descriptionHtml:

インサイドセールス担当者（ISR） 

職務概要 

インサイドセールス担当者（ISR）は営業部門に所属し、チャネルパートナーと緊密に連携しながら、法人顧客を対象とした営業活動を行います。AI活用が企業のIT投資を大きく動かすなか、データ基盤・ストレージを起点に、お客様のAI活用とデータ戦略を支援するポジションです。 

本ポジションは、SDRおよびISRの両方の役割を担います。 

  • SDRとして：マーケティング部門から提供されるTQL（電話で精査されたリード）を管理します。AIを活用したリード優先順位付け、顧客・業界リサーチ、パーソナライズしたアプローチ設計を通じて、質と量の両立を図ります。 
  • ISRとして：見積書の作成や商談の進行など、さまざまな活動を通じて担当地区の売上（Booking）に貢献します。 

また、Business Value Selling（BVS）の手法を活用し、AI・データ活用というお客様のビジネス目標に沿って商談を進め、成約へ導くことが期待されます。 

業務には以下が含まれます。 

  • 製品・ソリューションのウェブプレゼンテーション（AI/データ基盤ユースケースを含む） 
  • TCO（総所有コスト）計算 
  • 提案書の作成・提示 
  • 必要に応じたPOC（概念実証）の実施 
  • 見積書の作成 

主な職務内容 

  • インサイドセールス環境での販売目標達成とノルマの継続的達成 
  • 技術・営業リソースを活用し、チャネルパートナーとの関係構築を通じて商談を成約へ導く 
  • チャネルパートナーと密接に連携し、収益を創出（AI関連案件でのパートナー共創を含む） 
  • AIツール（生成AI、営業支援AI、会話インテリジェンス等）を日常業務に組み込み、リサーチ、アウトリーチ、提案書作成、商談後フォローなどを効率化し、顧客との対話や関係構築により多くの時間を割く 
  • パイプライン管理とコンバージョン率向上への注力。データに基づく分析で施策を継続的に改善する 
  • 高い活動量を維持し、大量販売に対応 
  • 正確な予測の提示と複数チャネルとの連携 
  • AI/データ活用に関するお客様の課題（学習・推論基盤、データ保護、サイバーレジリエンス、コスト最適化など）を把握し、ビジネス価値に基づいた提案書を作成・提示 
  • 四半期・年間ベースでのアカウント戦略推進とパートナーとの協働営業 
  • 意思決定者（IT部門に加え、データ・AI推進部門や事業部門を含む）へのアプローチと新規開拓の実績 
  • 営業現場で得られたAI活用の工夫やナレッジをチームに共有し、組織全体の生産性向上に貢献 

求める人物像・スキル 

必須要件（経験・実績） 

  • B2Bテクノロジー営業の経験（3年以上） 
  • ストレージ分野またはIT基盤分野での安定したノルマ達成の実績（達成率などの具体的な数字で示せること） 
  • チャネルパートナー（SIer、ディストリビューター、リセラー等）との協業による販売成功経験、およびチャネル販売モデルへの深い理解 
  • 開拓から成約まで営業プロセス全体をリードした実績 
  • 意思決定者（部長・役員クラス）へのアプローチと新規開拓の実績 
  • 提案書作成、TCO試算、見積作成を含む、ソリューション提案の経験 
  • Salesforce.comおよびMicrosoft Officeの操作スキル 
  • 優れた口頭・書面コミュニケーション能力 
  • 自律的に行動し、結果を出す力 
  • 優れた時間管理とマルチタスク能力 
  • 東京オフィスに通勤可能な地域に居住していること 
  • オープンオフィス・チーム環境での勤務に意欲があること 

歓迎要件 

  • ストレージ業界の深い知識（ブロック/ファイル/オブジェクト、データ保護、サイバーレジリエンスなど） 
  • AI/データ基盤（GPU環境、データレイク、非構造化データ管理など）に関する知識、またはAI関連案件の提案経験 
  • 生成AIや営業支援ツールを業務に取り入れ、生産性や成果を改善した経験 
  • BVSまたは関連するB2B営業トレーニングの修了 
  • 大企業とスタートアップ両方の環境での経験 
  • 関連分野の学士号 

求める姿勢 

  • 市場の変化（特にAI活用の拡大）を機会と捉え、新しい手法や知識を学び続ける姿勢 
  • 自身の営業経験にAIを掛け合わせ、成果を高めていく意欲 
  • 顧客の本質的な課題を発見し、信頼関係を築くことに価値を置くこと 
  • 強い競争心と高い労働倫理、企業代表としての責任感 
  • 新規機会の発掘と成約への情熱

title: Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer, Higher Education (Northeast)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MA / NY / PA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, data scientists, researchers, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required

  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers
  • Familiarity with HPC, research and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation

If you meet most of the required list and few of the second list, we would still like to hear from you.

title: Sr. Business Partner, Sales Operations
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Sales Operations Business Partner to partner closely with the India Sales Leader and District Managers across India. The role will provide dedicated operational support, business insight, and execution capacity to help sales leaders run their businesses effectively and improve seller productivity. Working as part of the APJ Sales Operations organisation, the Ops partner will own forecasting, pipeline management, performance analysis, business reviews, planning, and operational execution for the patch. The role reports to the APJ Theater Operations leader and will work closely with the India leadership team and Regional Sales Operations Business Partner to translate regional priorities into consistent execution at country and district level.

This is an advisory role. You are expected to explain why the numbers moved, recommend what to do about it, drive workflow improvement across the segments you support, and be in the room when the decision is made.

The role will create operating leverage through:

  • Country and district partnership: Providing the India Sales Leader and District Managers with the analysis, insight, and recommendations required to improve sales performance.
  • The three strategic pillars: Owning Territory & Account Planning, Forecasting, and Pipeline for India — the disciplines Sales Ops partners on, and where the partnership is judged.
  • Operating cadence: Owning forecast and pipeline reviews, business reviews, KPI reporting, and the follow-through needed to keep priorities on track.
  • Execution and follow-through: Operationalising agreed GTM priorities, tracking actions, upholding sales excellence and SFDC rigor and removing recurring friction for sellers and managers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with sales leaders: Work closely with the India Sales Leader and District Managers as a trusted business advisor, providing operational analysis, insight, and recommendations across their businesses.
  • Own weekly forecasting: Prepare and pressure-test the forecast and pipeline pre-read: explain week-to-week movement, quantify gap-to-close, frame risk and upside scenarios, name risks with owners, and set out the actions required.
  • Lead business reviews: Own country and district reviews end to end, including KPI analysis, performance commentary, action capture, and follow-up to closure.
  • Analyse performance: Assess pipeline coverage, conversion, linearity, seller productivity, territory, and account performance; diagnose root causes and translate findings into clear recommendations.
  • Territory and quota design: Lead territory analysis and design for India, model quota and run equity checks, and manage account assignment and white-space analysis, bringing options with clear trade-offs and working within agreed regional governance.
  • Account planning: Own the account planning standard in the patch — guidance, content standard and KPIs, the refresh cadence, and plans maintained live in SFDC rather than produced as audit artifacts. Review plan quality with District Managers and drive follow-up on gaps.
  • Annual planning campaign: Act as the analytical lead for the annual planning campaign across India — territory design, quota modelling, account assignment and scenario support — as a quarter-long program, not a single meeting.
  • Operationalise decisions & programmes: Lead the implementation and adoption of agreed GTM, organisational, and process changes with Regional Sales Operations and cross-functional teams.
  • Sales excellence & SFDC rigor: Own sales excellence by maintaining strict CRM (Salesforce) and forecasting hygiene: run the standard checks, surface data-quality and process issues to sales managers with named owners, and drive resolution.
  • Drive follow-through: Track actions, dependencies, and performance interventions arising from forecast calls, business reviews, and planning discussions, and close them out without prompting.
  • Improve processes and alignment: Recommend and implement practical improvements that reduce operational friction, and partner with Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and Corporate Operations to support execution.
  • Support account and deal execution: Coordinate account-planning, win/loss, and big-deal review cadences, providing analysis and tracking agreed actions through to completion.
  • Own pipeline coverage: Track create against target by source, run coverage and health analysis for CQ, Q+1 and Q+2, monitor hygiene (age, stage, BVS, pushed), and build remediation plans with Marketing, SE and Channel so that gaps surface a quarter early with a named plan.
  • Identify leading indicators: Monitor performance trends and leading indicators across pipeline, productivity, and execution, highlighting gaps early and proposing improvement initiatives.
  • Drive adoption and field feedback: Lead adoption of new processes and tools, gather structured feedback from the field, and work with Regional Sales Operations to recommend practical improvements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Partner with Channel Operations, SE Operations, Renewals Operations, Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and other relevant teams to align priorities, coordinate dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across India.
  • Improve workflows for scale: Improve the workflows behind recurring deliverables so they run consistently and at scale, and share the resulting working practice with Business Partners across the theater. This is influence, not people management.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

HOW WE WORK: THE PARTNERSHIP STANDARD

Insight, not just data. Every recurring deliverable answers three questions in order: what happened, why it happened, and what we recommend. A page that reports a number without naming the driver and the action does not meet the standard.
Prepared, never reactive. Every cadence has a standard pre-read prepared in advance: movement explained, gaps quantified, risks named with owners, and open actions carried forward.
Clear boundaries. Strategic work is owned; field-service work is performed as a bounded, time-boxed service; operational requests are routed to the owning function within one business day with context.
A trusted business partner. Objective perspective, constructive challenge, and recommendations grounded in data and business context. Forecasts and pipelines are pressure-tested with candour; hygiene and forecast discipline gaps are surfaced to the Sales Leader with named owners on their team.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, business analytics, or a related role, ideally within a multinational technology company, including experience partnering directly with a country or regional sales leader.
  • Sales leadership partnership: Experience partnering with sales managers and senior commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced sales organisation, including a track record of recommendations that changed a decision.
  • Sales operations knowledge: Strong understanding of forecasting, pipeline management, and performance management.
  • Territory and account planning: Hands-on experience with territory design, quota modelling and equity checks, account assignment and white-space analysis, and running an account planning standard across a sales team.
  • Analytical capability: Strong analytical and modelling skills, with the ability to interpret complex and incomplete data, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations with trade-offs.
  • AI fluency: Working fluency with AI tools such as Gemini and Claude for analysis, synthesis and workflow automation — able to build and run a repeatable AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual effort in reporting or analysis preparation. Deep technical AI experience is not expected.
  • Tools and systems: Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, forecasting tools such as Clari, Google Workspace (particularly Google Sheets), and BI or visualisation tools such as Tableau.
  • Execution discipline: Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional work, and maintain consistent follow-through with limited supervision.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and present evidence-based recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to drive security operations from our Prague, Czech Republic location. In this role, you will contribute to operational excellence across incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence integration, detection engineering, and security automation, bringing real-time visibility and rapid response to our 24/7 global security operations environment.

This is a technical delivery and execution role, not a traditional monitoring position. You will work closely with detection engineers, threat intelligence analysts, incident response leadership, and our global Security Operations teams to build and refine detections, improve signal quality, execute threat hunts, automate workflows, and respond to complex security incidents with speed and precision.

Success in this role is measured not by alert volume, but by signal quality, real threat detection, incident containment speed, automation maturity, and the effectiveness of response workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Detection Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain detections in Splunk and related security platforms. Develop detection-as-code content using formats such as YAML/JSON, incorporate unit and regression testing, map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK, and contribute to Sigma/YARA-L coverage expansion.
  • Incident Response & Triage: Investigate suspicious activity and participate in incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews. Use lessons from investigations to continuously improve detection and response processes.
  • Threat Hunting: Execute hypothesis-driven threat hunts using MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chains, threat intelligence, behavioral baselines, and anomaly detection. Correlate signals across endpoint, cloud, identity, SaaS, network, and other security telemetry to identify real threats and operational blind spots.
  • Detection Quality: Continuously tune detections to improve true-positive rates and reduce alert fatigue. Identify which signals provide meaningful security value and refine detection logic based on investigation outcomes and changes in the threat landscape.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Operationalize cyber threat intelligence (CTI) by mapping adversary tools, techniques, TTPs, and indicators to the Everpure environment and translating relevant intelligence into detection and hunting strategies.
  • Automation & Orchestration: Build Python scripts, API integrations, enrichment workflows, and SOAR automation using platforms such as Tines, XSOAR, or equivalent. Develop workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate investigation and containment while maintaining appropriate guardrails and logging.
  • Cloud & Container Security Monitoring: Monitor and investigate security signals across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and cloud audit logs. Identify container and Kubernetes runtime anomalies and contribute to monitoring cloud-native attack surfaces.
  • Agentic & AI-Assisted Workflows: Evaluate and implement AI-assisted security workflows, including LLM-based investigation and autonomous triage capabilities. Assess AI-generated detection logic while maintaining appropriate human oversight and guardrails.
  • Playbooks & Documentation: Develop and refine detection playbooks, investigation procedures, automated security playbooks, and operational runbooks to improve consistency, investigation rigor, and response effectiveness.
  • Security Operations Development: Help build detection content addressing threats such as credential abuse, privilege escalation, lateral movement, cloud misuse, insider risk, sensitive data movement, and unauthorized access.
  • Detection-as-Code & Automation Infrastructure: Contribute to Git-backed detection repositories, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, enrichment pipelines, remediation workflows, and response automation designed to reduce analyst toil and improve response times.
  • Global Collaboration: Partner with global Security Operations teams and contribute to a SOC culture focused on operational excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague, Czech Republic office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, incident response, detection engineering, security operations, or a related security discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience executing threat hunts, complex incident investigations, or detection engineering within a SOC or SIEM environment.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Splunk, including search, dashboards, alerts, correlation searches, saved searches, deployment server, and forwarder management.
  • Strong understanding of the complete incident response lifecycle, including triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident learning.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, operating systems, cloud environments, and security architecture across identity, endpoint, network, and cloud.
  • Experience developing Python scripts for data processing, API integrations, security tooling, and automation.
  • Strong understanding of threat intelligence and attacker frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chains, and TTPs.
  • Hands-on experience with threat hunting methodologies, including hypothesis-driven hunting, behavioral baselines, and anomaly detection.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Detection-as-code experience, including Sigma, ECMA/JSON detection formats, Git-backed detection repositories, unit testing, MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping, Splunk Security Content, or similar detection frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with security automation and SOAR platforms such as Tines, XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent, including API-driven enrichment and response workflows.
  • Cloud security operations experience across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure, including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, cloud audit logs, and cloud-native attack surfaces.
  • Container and Kubernetes security experience, including Falco, container runtime monitoring, image scanning, vulnerability management, or software supply chain security.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing agentic or AI-assisted security workflows, including LLM-assisted investigations, autonomous triage, or AI-generated detections, with an understanding of appropriate guardrails and human oversight.
  • Experience operationalizing threat intelligence, including PIRs, CTI-to-detection pipelines, and intelligence-driven threat hunting.
  • Experience with Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages and exposure to infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience working within follow-the-sun security operations models and with security operations metrics such as MTTD, MTTA, and MTTC.
  • Experience with Attack Surface Management, including secret hygiene, identity attack surface, and Shadow AI.
  • Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, AWS Security Specialty, CKS, or equivalent.

THE ROLE

Are you ready to shape the future of financial reporting at a fast-paced, innovative technology leader? As Senior Manager, External Reporting, you will drive Everpure’s public financial reporting integrity and compliance across U.S. GAAP and SEC standards. Partnering cross-functionally across Finance, Legal, Investor Relations, and external audit, you will champion reporting excellence, elevate technical accounting analysis, and modernise processes with AI and automation tools.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the preparation and review of SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement support, XBRL tagging, and other required disclosures
  • Oversee the tie-out of financial statements, footnotes, and Management’s Discussion & Analysis (MD&A), including statement of cash flows, statement of stockholders’ equity, earnings per share, and non-GAAP disclosures, as applicable
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, SEC regulations (including Regulations S-K and S-X), and disclosure controls and procedures (DC&P)
  • Manage the external reporting calendar and coordinate deliverables across finance, legal, investor relations, and external auditors
  • Review and analyze financial results to ensure consistency and accuracy of disclosures
  • Review accounting analyses and journal entries related to stock-based compensation (ASC 718), including expense recognition, forfeitures, modifications, equity classification, and diluted EPS impacts, in coordination with Stock Administration
  • Review accounting for capitalized sales commissions / contract acquisition costs (ASC 340-40), including capitalization, amortization, and impairment assessments
  • Support the evaluation of technical accounting matters, including preparation and review of accounting memos and documentation for complex or non-routine transactions
  • Maintain and enhance internal controls over financial reporting (SOX), with emphasis on disclosure controls, reporting processes, and key controls over external reporting
  • Support earnings release preparation and review, including coordination with Investor Relations and review of supporting analyses
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors on reporting, disclosure, and select technical accounting areas
  • Drive continuous improvement in the external reporting process by identifying and implementing automation and AI-enabled solutions (e.g., for tie-outs, variance analysis, disclosure drafting, and data validation) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Continuously improve reporting processes, including leveraging systems and automation tools (e.g., Workiva, ERP systems) to enhance efficiency and shorten reporting timelines
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Extensive expertise in U.S. GAAP and SEC public company reporting, with hands-on experience leading multi-faceted technical accounting evaluations and journal entries (including ASC 718 and ASC 340-40).
  • Experience reviewing cash flow statements, stockholders’ equity, EPS, and related supporting schedules
  • Demonstrated capability in orchestrating complex financial reporting deliverables, managing SOX/DC&P frameworks, and leveraging modern financial reporting tools and ERP systems (e.g. Workiva, NetSuite, SAP, E*Trade).
  • Advanced skills in workflow automation, process improvement, and implementing technology- or AI-enabled tools to optimize financial data validation and disclosure drafting.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, experience in mentoring staff, analytical problem-solving, and communication capabilities to align cross-departmental partners and executive stakeholders.

  • Drive adoption and field feedback: Support adoption of new processes and tools, gather structured feedback from the field, and work with Regional Sales Operations to recommend practical improvements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Partner with Channel Operations, SE Operations, Renewals Operations, Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and other relevant teams to align priorities, coordinate dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across the district.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • PCB Architecture & Fabrication Optimization: Direct PCB material selection, multilayer stack-up design, dielectric properties, and fabrication requirements in partnership with hardware designers and fabrication suppliers to maximize signal integrity, ensure impedance control, and eliminate manufacturability risks before release.
  • SMT & Assembly Process Qualification: Define, optimize, and qualify SMT and mixed-technology assembly processes—including solder paste printing, component placement, reflow, and selective soldering—collaborating with Contract Manufacturers to achieve first-pass yield targets and robust solder joint integrity.
  • Advanced Defect Screening & Testability Engineering: Drive production readiness and defect elimination by deploying and calibrating automated inspection and test strategies (SPI, AOI, X-ray, ICT, and functional test) with test engineering teams, ensuring comprehensive probe access, boundary scan coverage, and rapid root-cause isolation.
  • DFX Reviews & BOM management (Via PLM Tool): Lead comprehensive Gerber, fabrication drawing, assembly, test interaction and BOM reviews in PLM tools to mitigate design risks, optimize assembly hierarchies, and accelerate successful NPI transitions to high-volume manufacturing. Structure and maintain accurate BOMs in tools such as Agile, including part relationships, revisions, assembly and manufacturing data.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Expertise in PCB Fabrication & Stack-up Design: Mastery of PCB materials, dielectric properties, laminate systems, high-layer-count stack-ups, controlled impedance, and transmission-line behavior (including TDR and S-parameter analysis) for high-speed digital architecture.
  • Comprehensive SMT & PCBA Manufacturing Skills: Deep technical knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT) assembly, solder paste printing, reflow profile optimization, pick-and-place process tuning, selective soldering, and IPC standards compliance for high-reliability electronics.
  • Advanced DFX & CAD Data Analysis: Expertise reviewing Gerber files, drill data, CAM tools, and manufacturing drawings to implement actionable Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Testability (DFT) improvements.
  • Data-Driven Quality & Inspection Mastery: Hands-on proficiency with process characterization tools including SPI, AOI, X-ray, ICT, test-point strategies, and statistical process control to identify root causes and drive continuous yield improvement.
