title: Principal Solutions Architect, Technology Alliances
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE:

Everpure is building the Enterprise Data Cloud — data unified, governed and understood as one intelligent system, and the foundation enterprises build AI on. No vendor delivers that alone. Our key Alliance Partners own software and infrastructures layers that sit either side of Everpure, and the joint solutions we build with them are what customers actually deploy. When a joint solution is validated, documented and carried by both field organizations, it compounds across every account either company touches.

We are investing behind a small number of strategic Alliance Partners. The Principal Solutions Architect, Technology Alliances is the technical owner of that relationship: the person embedded with the partner's own architects, engineering and product teams, building the joint solutions that both companies take to market.

This is a partner-facing, solution-led role rather than a field or customer-facing one. Your counterparts are the partner's technical leadership, not end customers. You will spend your time inside the alliance, designing integrations, validating architectures, building the technical content that enables two field organisations, and carrying what you learn back into Everpure Product Management. You are the conduit in both directions.

You wake up thinking about one thing: how to build innovative joint solutions that drives business with these partners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Build the joint solution

  • Own the technical definition of joint solutions with your Alliance Partners end to end: use case selection, reference architecture, integration design, validation and publication.
  • Prove the solution works. Run joint labs, interoperability testing and validated designs that stand up under customer scrutiny
  • Design across the full Everpure platform, not a single product line, and design for how the partner's technology is actually deployed and consumed.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. A small number of joint solutions that both field teams can sell beats a long catalogue nobody uses.

Be the conduit to Product Management

  • Bring partner requirements back into Everpure Product Management with clarity and evidence: integration gaps, API and automation needs, certification and roadmap dependencies.
  • Represent Everpure's roadmap to the partner's technical and product teams, and align release timing so joint solutions land together rather than sequentially.
  • Maintain the working relationship between the two engineering and product organisations so issues are resolved between teams, not escalated between executives.
  • Gather and structure feedback continuously; this is a standing responsibility, not a quarterly exercise.

Drive business through the partnership

  • Translate joint solutions into pipeline. Define the plays, the target use cases and the qualification criteria that let both field organizations act on them.
  • Build the technical evidence base that makes the joint solution winnable: positioning, competitive differentiation, proof points and reference outcomes.
  • Work with Alliance and sales leadership on the joint go-to-market plan, and hold the technical half of it.
  • Support the partner's field and sales teams as the escalation point on joint solution architecture.

Build technical credibility with the partner

  • Establish yourself as the trusted technical voice with the partner's architects, product managers and CTOs.
  • Enable the partner's technical community to position and design Everpure autonomously, so every engagement builds capability beyond the ones you are in.
  • Grow a population of partner-side technical champions who advocate for Everpure without you in the room.

Create the IP

  • Produce reusable technical assets from live joint work: reference architectures, validated designs, sizing and scaling guidance, deployment and integration guides.
  • Build enablement content and deliver it to both organisations' technical communities.
  • Represent Everpure at partner-facing events, joint roadshows, webinars and technical workshops, and create content that reaches the partner's wider technical ecosystem.

Work across Everpure

  • Orchestrate specialist and engineering support cleanly rather than carrying every technical ask personally.
  • Work with the wider Global Partner Technical Organization so joint solutions built in one alliance are reusable across others.

WHAT YOU BRING:

Alliances and commercial

  • 10+ years in pre-sales, solutions architecture or technical leadership, with a demonstrable record of building partner or alliance-led business.
  • Direct experience working with technology alliance partners, and a real understanding of how joint solutions get built, certified, launched and sold by two organizations at once.
  • Commercial fluency. Comfortable connecting technical design decisions to joint pipeline, revenue and the partner's own business model.
  • Track record of influencing product direction on the basis of partner and market evidence.

Technical

  • Credible at depth across modern data platform architecture: block, file and object, unstructured data at scale, hybrid and cloud data services, Kubernetes and as-a-service models.
  • Strong working knowledge of compute, database, networking and virtualisation, plus emerging areas including AI/ML data pipelines and data governance and classification.
  • Fluent in cyber resilience, data protection architecture, virtualisation migration dynamics and the competitive landscape.
  • Practical command of integration and API-driven infrastructure, and the discipline of validated reference architecture.
  • Product experience across technology vendors within the relevant region.

Communication and presence

  • Outstanding written, diagrammatic and verbal communication, with the ability to reduce complex ideas to simple terms for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Executive presence to move between a partner CTO conversation and a joint whiteboard architecture session.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across the broader Everpure organization and to influence without authority — in both companies.

Way of working

  • Entrepreneurial and ambitious. Alliances reward the people who create the agenda rather than wait for it.
  • Combines a big-thinking strategic perspective with a detail-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Thrives in ambiguity and pace, prioritises ruthlessly, and drives for results with a strong sense of accountability.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior analyst who builds. Not someone who specs a dashboard and hands it to a BI developer — someone who takes an ambiguous business question, models the data behind it, designs the interface, ships it as a working web application, and then sits with the stakeholder who uses it. You'll work across the business — People, Finance, Products, and other lines of business — building custom, web-based analytics products that people actually open on a Monday morning. You'll use AI and GenAI tools (including Claude) to move from idea to deployed prototype in days rather than quarters, without the constraints of traditional BI platforms. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will spend your time in SQL, in data models, in code, and in front of the people who depend on what you build.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own analytics products end to end. Gather requirements directly from business stakeholders, model the underlying data, build the dashboard, validate it, deploy it, and iterate on real usage independently.
  • Design and ship custom web-based dashboards. Build intelligent, self-serve analytics experiences as real web applications, using AI and GenAI tools to rapidly prototype and implement solutions that off-the- shelf BI tools can't deliver.
  • Make the data trustworthy. Build clean, well-documented data models in SQL. Partner with data engineering and platform engineering so what you ship is scalable, reliable, and audit-ready in production.
  • Design for the reader, not the data. Decide what belongs on the screen and what doesn't. Make hierarchy, layout, and chart choice do real work, so an executive gets the answer in five seconds and an analyst can still drill to the detail.
  • Turn findings into decisions. Translate complex analysis into a clear narrative for senior leadership — making the story behind the numbers as rigorous as the numbers themselves — and follow through until the insight changes something.
  • Prototype where AI helps. Explore and deploy AI-powered analytics capabilities — natural-language querying, automated narrative, anomaly surfacing — where they make a product genuinely more useful.
  • Become the domain expert. Learn the business processes behind the numbers deeply enough that your outputs are grounded in real strategy, not just in what data happens to exist.

  • Proven ability to build and deploy web-based analytics applications. You've shipped dashboards as real web apps, not just BI workbooks. Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, or with frameworks such as React, Streamlit, Dash, or Plotly — and with using AI coding tools to get from prototype to production quickly.

While the Operations PM owns the factory and schedule, you own test engineering readiness against that schedule, ensuring test engineering is never the surprise at a gate review. You will differentiate this role by translating build milestones into test deliverables at each assembly level, and feeding real constraints back into planning to empower engineers to focus on technical execution.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Maintain an integrated view of every commitment across L6 and L10 NPI, production, qualifications, and test strategy, driving cross-functional dependencies, owners, and timelines in one place.
  • Own gate and checkpoint readiness at every L6 and L10 milestone by tracking test coverage, ICT fixture availability, parts lead times, and test software releases to ensure seamless deployments.
  • Facilitate strategic communication, conflict resolution, and architectural decisions, identifying risks early and arriving at gate reviews with a recommended mitigation path.
  • Absorb status reporting, granular logistics, and dashboard maintenance for team workloads, enabling engineers to remain focused exclusively on technical deliverables.
  • Solve for root causes and refine organizational workflows to prevent recurrence, framing trade-offs and forcing closure to ensure continuous program momentum.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • A proven track record leading concurrent NPI programs with comprehensive exposure to both board-level (L6) and system-level (L10) manufacturing hardware tests.
  • Technical fluency in manufacturing test processes—including ICT, functional test, burn-in, End of Line system test, and yield workflows—enabling you to independently challenge estimates and assess risk.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to compress a complex portfolio into actionable insights tailored for leadership and operational partners.
  • Advanced proficiency with program management and tracking tools (such as Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, or Confluence) to synthesize complex data and provide full visibility for successful outcomes.
  • A proactive approach to mitigating downstream risks by identifying critical path dependencies early, rather than merely relaying ambiguous problems or managing immediate exceptions.

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Join the Pure1 platform engineering team to take ownership of Phonehome.next—our mission-critical, Tier-0 ingest and streaming backbone. Every day, thousands of FlashArray and FlashBlade appliances across the globe stream real-time telemetry and state data through this service directly into the Pure1 cloud platform. Multiple internal product and engineering teams depend on Phonehome.next to power analytics, proactive support, and fleet-wide management.

You’ll be building directly for other engineering teams at Everpure. Think of yourself as the guardian of our shared Protobuf contract between the appliances and the cloud: keeping it bulletproof, keeping it backward-compatible, and making sure nothing gets lost along the way.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the end-to-end design, reliability, performance, and scaling of Phonehome.next, our Tier-0 telemetry streaming service handling continuous data streams from enterprise appliances worldwide.

  • Safeguard and evolve the Protobuf data contracts and gRPC APIs bridging physical storage appliances and cloud systems, ensuring strict correctness, high throughput, and seamless backward compatibility.

  • Act as a technical partner and consultant for internal engineering teams, guiding their architectural integrations, unblocking dependencies, and onboarding new consumers onto the platform.

  • Design and scale event-driven data streaming pipelines utilizing Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, and a growing Apache Iceberg analytical ecosystem on AWS.

  • Maintain operational excellence by participating in a balanced on-call rotation (one week in five), running blameless postmortems, and driving systemic fixes directly back into production code.

  • Drive automated infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native deployments across AWS and Kubernetes using Terraform, maintaining robust CI/CD and observability standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

    • Extensive experience building, maintaining, and scaling mission-critical, high-throughput distributed systems in production (Tier-0 / 24x7 environments).

    • Strong programming proficiency in Go (Golang), with a deep understanding of concurrent programming, memory management, and network I/O.

    • Hands-on expertise with event streaming and caching architectures, specifically Apache Kafka, Redis, and document/NoSQL stores like MongoDB.

    • Proven experience defining API and data schemas using gRPC and Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) with a strong focus on backward compatibility and API versioning.

    • Solid experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes and orchestrating cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform.

    • Exposure to modern analytical data formats and pipelines (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or large-scale data lakes) is a strong plus.

    • Empathy and communication skills to partner with internal engineering stakeholders, balance operational rigor with developer velocity, and mentor peers through code reviews and blameless postmortems.

    • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague, Czechia office in compliance with Pure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

Be a technical expert and in areas of storage, artificial intelligence, SDN, SaaS solutions, networking, dev-ops, machine learning, analytics, competition and channels business dynamics

Based in the Dubai, you will be the primary hands-on technical resource embedded with customers and delivery teams for Portworx Enterprise, PX-Backup, PX-DR, and modern virtualization (KubeVirt) engagements — supporting everything from design workshops and deployment through day-2 operations and break/fix support. This is a proactive, customer-facing, problem-solving role for someone who is comfortable working directly in customer production Kubernetes environments, mastering containerisation and DevOps practices, and troubleshooting complex, mission-critical infrastructure under pressure.

WHY THIS ROLE

Cloud Native / Portworx is one of Everpure's fastest-growing service lines in EMEA, underpinning our broader Enterprise Data Cloud and Cloud & App Modernization strategy. WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, install, configure, and maintain Kubernetes clusters and Portworx-based solutions using best practices, Kubernetes manifests, and Helm charts

  • Lead API/microservices solution deployment and day-2 operations, including monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana/other Observability and alerting best practices

  • Support customers through validation and testing of changes prior to production implementation, remediating issues identified during testing
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training sessions to customer teams to support ongoing Portworx operations
  • Maintain clear, ongoing communication with customer stakeholders and the Everpure delivery team on project status, risks, and outcomes

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Work within Everpure's Advanced Services delivery methodology, supporting Delivery/Solution Architects and Project Managers through the full engagement lifecycle
  • Collaborate with Certified Delivery Partners and customer/vendor teams (e.g., system integrators, platform teams) as part of a coordinated delivery effort
  • Contribute field experience back into repeatable procedures, runbooks, and templates to standardize delivery and improve quality across engagements

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments; experience building and operating containerised solutions
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and a strong understanding of the cloud-native technology landscape
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers directly, including comfort working on customer sites/production environments and communicating technical progress clearly

Technical Skills

  • In-depth experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting Kubernetes environments; proficiency with at least one of OpenShift, Rancher, Mirantis, or other orchestrators
  • Familiarity with other container orchestration platforms.
  • Linux system administration experience (RHEL, SLES, Debian, Ubuntu)
  • Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing)
  • Software-defined storage concepts (NFS, Block, iSCSI) and understanding of open-source databases/modern data platforms supporting highly available business applications
  • CI/CD experience (Jenkins, GitOps, Argo, Airflow) and Configuration Management/Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible)
  • Working knowledge of cloud IaaS environments such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
  • Familiarity with backup, disaster recovery, and object storage management in cloud and on-prem environments
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related field, or equivalent experience

Desirable Additional Skills and Certifications

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or CKAD qualification, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Scripting skills (Bash, Python, Ruby)
  • Virtualisation technologies (KVM, VMware) and version control systems (Git, SVN)
  • Monitoring and logging tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
  • Security fundamentals (SSL/TLS, Kubernetes Secrets, RBAC)
  • Experience with the OpenStorage SDK (REST and gRPC interfaces)
  • Experience with HA deployments for modern scale-out databases and data processing solutions (Cassandra, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch)
  • Cloud or Portworx-related certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Pure Certified Portworx Enterprise Professional)

Soft Skills

  • Attention to detail and strong troubleshooting discipline in complex, high-pressure environments
  • Comfortable consulting on customer sites related to complex solutions
  • Strong, clear communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Adaptability and a proactive, collaborative approach to problem-solving

Logistics

In this senior individual contributor role, you will operate with significant autonomy and influence, leading our most complex and highest-visibility operational audits across the business and partnering directly with senior leaders to evaluate risk, strengthen processes, and shape how the business makes decisions. This position requires strong business acumen, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to independently manage complex audits from planning through reporting, while bringing a point of view that senior stakeholders seek out before decisions are made.

The ideal candidate brings deep operational audit experience, business process and enterprise risk expertise, data analytics capabilities, and a passion for leveraging emerging technologies, including the use of AI embedded into audit activities to improve audit quality and efficiency. You hold yourself and the function to a standard of integrity that never bends to timeline pressure, and you escalate control or policy gaps with a proposed solution, not a workaround. Beyond executing audits, this role sets the agenda for its areas of coverage, drives durable remediation of systemic risks across the organization, serves as a sought-after voice before key decisions are made, and raises the standard for the broader audit function. This is NOT a SOX-focused role. Instead, the position emphasizes operational audits, business process and enterprise risk assessment, and strategic partnership across the organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead complex, ambiguous, and high-visibility operational audits and advisory engagements from planning through reporting, often spanning multiple functions, systems, or geographies, with full accountability for quality, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Set the risk assessment and audit agenda for your areas of coverage, determining scope, depth, priorities, and appropriate trade-offs.
  • Proactively identify untapped risks or improvement opportunities ahead of the audit plan, and pressure-test whether the function’s coverage and priorities are ambitious enough - not just execute against what’s already scoped.
  • Develop risk-based audit objectives, scope, and testing procedures aligned with business and organizational priorities.
  • Conduct process walkthroughs, control testing, data analysis, and evidence evaluation to assess the effectiveness of business processes and controls.
  • Identify systemic risks, control gaps, and process improvement opportunities; assess root cause and business impact; and develop practical recommendations.
  • Drive accountability for remediation of significant and systemic issues to sustainable resolution - regardless of where formal ownership sits - by building alignment across stakeholders, including where you do not have formal authority.
  • Prepare and present clear, concise audit reports that communicate findings, business impact, root causes, and recommended actions to senior stakeholders.
  • Leverage data analytics, predictive techniques, AI, and emerging technologies to enhance risk identification, audit coverage, insight, efficiency, and quality, while applying appropriate professional judgment and validation.
  • Build durable, repeatable solutions - through automation, standardized methodology, or AI-enabled approaches - that are adopted beyond your own engagements and continue to operate without requiring your ongoing involvement. 
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business and functional leaders, proactively bringing a  risk, control, and process point of view into strategic initiatives and key business decisions before they are finalized - and being direct when you disagree with the course being taken.
  • Support Internal Audit operations and broader CFO organization initiatives, including planning, performance metrics, methodology for IA and Finance-org wide learning, capability building, and talent development.
  • Set a high standard for audit quality and professionalism and coach, mentor, and develop other auditors.
  • Manage multiple complex tasks effectively prioritizing competing demands while maintaining a high standard of quality, judgment, and attention to detail.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

  • Track record of mentoring colleagues at multiple levels, contributing to hiring, and helping shape standards and practices for the broader function, not just coaching your immediate project team.
  • Deep understanding of business processes, enterprise and operational risk, risk assessment methodologies, and internal control concepts across diverse functional areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and drive alignment, change, and remediation across functions without formal authority.
  • Proven experience identifying systemic issues, performing root cause analysis, and driving sustainable remediation.
  • Experience conducting process walkthroughs, control testing, evidence evaluation, and audit reporting.
  • Proficiency using data analytics to support risk assessment, audit planning, testing, and insight generation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Amplify Brand & Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with Brand Marketing to design a visually compelling report, fact sheet and sustainability web site, and partner with Global Communications to oversee an integrated communication plan that heightens the sustainability profile of Everpure globally.

Everpure is looking for a Senior Services Solution Architect to lead the development of Advanced Services capabilities across AI data platforms and production AI, helping customers turn enterprise data and AI use cases into validated, production-ready solutions.

This is a senior, innovation-focused Professional Services role responsible for identifying customer and market opportunities, shaping technical approaches, validating them through customer engagements and pilots, and maturing successful concepts into scalable, repeatable services and capabilities.

You will act as a senior Advanced Services technical authority for AI, working closely with our AI pre-sales teams, Product Engineering, partners, and delivery organizations. You will combine strong AI and data architecture expertise with hands-on experimentation to help customers progress from use-case definition and prototype through data preparation, model and retrieval evaluation, integration, and production.

The role sits at the intersection of AI, enterprise data and customer execution. It is not a generic AI application-development role, nor an infrastructure-only role. The focus is applying AI to real customer problems, proving what works, and establishing the data, architecture and operational foundations required to run it successfully in production.

What You'll Do

  • Shape AI Services Strategy: Help define the Advanced Services strategy and capabilities for AI, identifying customer needs, emerging use cases, technology trends, and opportunities to accelerate adoption.
  • Validate AI Requirements: Work with strategic customers to understand AI use cases and translate them into the data, platform and services requirements necessary to move from concept to production.
  • Architect AI Data Solutions: Design architectures spanning enterprise data, preparation and transformation, retrieval, embeddings, vectorization, knowledge architectures, model integration, and AI consumption.
  • Drive DataStream Services: Develop discovery methodologies, corpus assessment, deployment patterns, reference architectures, sizing, retrieval optimization and production-readiness approaches around DataStream and associated AI data pipelines.
  • Lead Pilot-Led Innovation: Work in an FDE-style model with customers through discovery, prototype, MVP and pilot phases, iterating rapidly and turning successful approaches into scalable delivery capability.
  • Productionize AI Solutions: Help customers move from experimentation into production, addressing model and retrieval quality, performance, observability, governance, resiliency, operational readiness, and lifecycle requirements.
  • Bridge Pre-Sales and Delivery: Partner closely with AI FSAs, AI specialists, Product Engineering, partners, and delivery teams to transition emerging AI opportunities into executable customer engagements.
  • Influence Product and Services Direction: Capture learning from real customer deployments and create feedback loops into Product Engineering and the wider organization to improve products, architectures, and future services.
  • Accelerate Services Growth: Influence pipeline and strategic opportunities by translating complex customer requirements into credible architectures, pilots, and repeatable engagement models.

What You Bring

  • AI Expertise: Proven experience designing, prototyping, and deploying enterprise AI/ML or GenAI solutions, with the ability to operate beyond proof-of-concept environments.
  • AI & Data Architecture: Strong experience across data preparation, ingestion, transformation, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vectorization, and modern enterprise data architectures.
  • GenAI and Retrieval Expertise: Practical experience with RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, model integration, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Model & Retrieval Understanding: Strong understanding of how model selection, inference, embeddings, retrieval and evaluation affect the design of enterprise AI data platforms. You do not need to be a model developer or data scientist.
  • Production AI Experience: Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, observability, deployment automation, model and data lifecycle management, performance tuning, reliability, and operationalization.
  • Modern AI Platform Awareness: Strong understanding of the infrastructure and platforms supporting modern AI environments, including cloud, Kubernetes, GPU-enabled architectures, storage, and networking. Deep infrastructure engineering expertise is not required.
  • Hands-On Technical Credibility: Ability to move comfortably between architecture and implementation, prototype solutions, diagnose technical challenges, and make sound trade-offs when an initial approach does not work.
  • Professional Services Experience: Experience working directly with enterprise customers, rapidly characterizing ambiguous requirements, defining practical delivery paths, and progressing engagements from discovery through pilot and production.

descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The FlashBlade team builds the industry’s most innovative, high-performance, and highly available portfolio of products that are designed for the most demanding mission critical applications.  While we deliver a hardware storage array, over 90% of our engineering staff are software engineers. Our customers are the most important part of our business and they love FlashBlade for its simplicity of management, the constant flow of new and exciting upgrades, and ability to live on the cutting edge of technology while never taking downtime, ever. FlashBlade enables our customers to leverage the agility of the public cloud for both traditional IT and cloud-native applications. You’ll architect, implement, and optimize core services that span on-premises arrays and cloud deployments—delivering seamless storage experiences to enterprises around the globe. If you thrive on solving hard problems, influencing technical direction, and driving innovation end-to-end, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU AND YOUR TEAM WILL BE DOING…

· Own the platform software architecture for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs across FlashArray and FlashBlade, from concept and ERD/PRD review through bring-up, validation, manufacturing handoff and GA.
· Define and drive the platform security architecture, including Platform Root of Trust (PRoT), UEFI Secure Boot, Platform Firmware Resilience (PFR), TPM, measured boot, device identity and attestation, and boot drive encryption.
· Extend the secure boot chain of trust across firmware, bootloaders, kernel, Purity software and devices (BMC, NICs, HBAs, drives). Work with the security team on key management, the signing infrastructure and the production vs. development provisioning flows.
· Drive the post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness roadmap for platform firmware and boot, and keep us aligned with industry frameworks such as OCP Security / SAFE, NIST SP 800-193 and NIST SSDF.
· Architect secure, resilient firmware update and lifecycle flows: fw_update_tool, factory images, manufacturing provisioning and lock, RMA and re-provisioning, and non-disruptive hardware upgrades.
· Lead early hardware bring-up and debug for new CPUs, chipsets, PCIe switches, NICs and add-in cards. Partner with silicon vendors (Intel, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell and others) and with ODM/JDM partners.
· Shape the long-term direction for unifying hardware-adjacent management layers (chassis manager, HAL, BMC interfaces) across FlashArray and FlashBlade.
· Review hardware designs, ERDs and requirements so that platform software, diagnostics and manageability are designed in from day one, not bolted on later.
· Work with BMC Firmware, Kernel IO, Diags, Systems Networking, Hardware, Manufacturing, Security and Program Management teams in Bengaluru, Silicon Valley and Prague.
· Own root-cause analysis for the hardest platform, boot and security escalations, from internal test through customer field issues.
· Write the design documents and architectural reviews that set standards for the org. Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across teams.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE...

· 15+ years of experience in platform, system or firmware software for servers, storage, networking or other enterprise systems.
· A proven track record as the technical lead or architect on multiple NPI programs taken from bring-up to production.
· Deep, hands-on expertise in platform security: UEFI Secure Boot, hardware root of trust, TPM 2.0, measured boot, and code-signing and key-management workflows. Experience with Intel PFR, Caliptra, OpenTitan or a similar RoT is a strong plus.
· Strong understanding of the x86 boot flow (BIOS/UEFI, bootloaders, Linux kernel boot), plus experience working with BIOS vendors and silicon reference code.
· Solid knowledge of BMC and out-of-band management (IPMI, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, SPDM).
· Strong knowledge of hardware interfaces and system architecture: PCIe Gen5/Gen6, I2C/SMBus, SPI, eSPI, CPLD/FPGA interactions, CPU/NUMA architecture.
· Strong Linux systems programming and kernel/driver experience. Expert-level C, plus proficiency in Python and shell.
· Excellent debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries using JTAG, logic and protocol analyzers, serial consoles, crash dumps and boot logs.
· Experience working directly with silicon vendors, ODM/JDM partners and manufacturing teams.
· Proven ability to lead and influence through technical credibility across distributed teams without direct authority.
· Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
· Good to have: knowledge of PQC algorithms and migration, Common Criteria / FIPS certification, OCP standards, and ARM-based platforms.
· Storage experience is desirable but not required.
· You are flexible, accountable and a strong communicator who thrives in a globally distributed team.

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

  • Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.
  • Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.
  • Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.
  • Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.
  • Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.
  • Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.
  • Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

  • Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.
  • Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.
  • Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.
  • Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.
  • Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

  • Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.
  • Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.
  • Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

  • Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.
  • Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.
  • Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.
  • Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.

Documentation and Support

  • Document each model's logic, inputs and outputs clearly enough for it to be built into automated systems and tested against reference cases.
  • Support Value Consultants, sellers and sales engineers on large or complex deals where a standard model needs adapting, including in pricing discussions.

Who You'll Work With

  • Competitive intelligence: competitor pricing and benchmarks
  • Data and analytics: data sources, architecture and governance for model inputs
  • Product management and product marketing: product capabilities, pricing and roadmap
  • Finance and Monetisation: pricing and discounting
  • Sales teams and leadership: real-world feedback on live deals
  • Engineering and platform teams: building the models into automated systems

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, value engineering or management consulting, ideally at a large consulting firm, financial services company or technology vendor.
  • Deep financial analysis and modelling skills, with a strong grasp of cash flow, P&L and financial accounting, including CapEx versus OpEx, depreciation and subscription models.
  • Deep knowledge of ROI and TCO, and the practical use of IRR, NPV and payback to justify business cases.
  • The ability to turn complex technical and commercial information into clear, defensible financial logic.
  • A rigorous approach to assumptions, data quality and version control.
  • Strong written and verbal communication of both qualitative and quantitative business cases, including the ability to turn financial outputs into a compelling narrative for non-finance audiences.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially sales, product, monetisation and platform teams.
  • Self-managed, responsive and curious, with the creativity to find new, sound ways to quantify value.

Preferred Background

  • A professional accounting or finance qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA, or a Master's degree with a financial background.
  • Pre-sales or commercial finance experience at a technology vendor.
  • Knowledge of enterprise technology or IT infrastructure.

title: Offering Tools Finance Lead
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Offering Tools Finance Lead

Purpose

Everpure is looking for a Business Case Finance Lead to build the financial models behind customer business cases. You will build CFO-grade, repeatable and standardised value logic for products across Everpure's portfolio, and own the assumptions, benchmarks and inputs that keep those models accurate. The models feed directly into our wider automated sales operating model, so sellers everywhere present customers with the same credible, defensible numbers.

These models will underpin the proposals used across the entire sales organisation, and form the core of the business cases that go in front of customers. They will cover a wide range of deal sizes, products and industries, so they need to be consistent, robust and adaptable.

The role has three parts:

  • Identify the value. Understand how each product creates measurable value for customers, across cost efficiency, growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.
  • Build the model. Convert that value into a repeatable, standardised financial model, including cash flow, P&L and return metrics, that works across accounts and deal sizes.
  • Tell the financial story. Translate the model and its outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that increases the impact of every proposal with customers, including their CFOs and finance teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Credible, robust and accurate financial models underpin the portfolio of Everpure products.
  • Models are repeatable and standardised, and can be fed into customer proposals through our wider automated operating model.
  • Models and financials are translated into a compelling financial narrative that resonates with customers, including CFOs and finance teams.
  • Governance is in place around model inputs, with assumptions validated, updated and maintained.
  • Existing models are continually refined as new data is collected and new products are released.

What You'll Be Doing

Value and Financial Models

  • Identify how each product creates measurable value for customers across the key value levers: cost efficiency, revenue growth or protection, sustainability and risk reduction.
  • Build CFO-grade financial models, including cash flow and P&L, for each product across the portfolio.
  • Standardise models around common inputs and outputs, so they can be repeated efficiently and consistently across accounts and products.
  • Apply a consistent methodology and accounting treatment, with ROI, TCO, NPV, IRR and payback calculated the same way every time.
  • Continuously improve model accuracy, and develop new, financially robust ways to quantify value.

Financial Narrative

  • Translate model outputs into a clear, compelling financial narrative that shows customers what the investment means for their business.
  • Turn complex financial results into tangible measures that customers and sellers can relate to.
  • Help sellers position the business case confidently, in executive language.

Assumptions, Inputs and Governance

  • Own, govern and maintain the global assumptions, benchmarks and financial inputs feeding the models.
  • Identify and add the new pricing, product advances and market trends the models need, within an agreed SLA.
  • Define the source, owner and refresh cadence for every input, and maintain a clear version history.
  • Reconcile model outputs against real deals to check accuracy over time.

Documentation and Support

  • Document each model's logic, inputs and outputs clearly enough for it to be built into automated systems and tested against reference cases.
  • Support Value Consultants, sellers and sales engineers on large or complex deals where a standard model needs adapting, including in pricing discussions.

Who You'll Work With

  • Competitive intelligence: competitor pricing and benchmarks
  • Data and analytics: data sources, architecture and governance for model inputs
  • Product management and product marketing: product capabilities, pricing and roadmap
  • Finance and Monetisation: pricing and discounting
  • Sales teams and leadership: real-world feedback on live deals
  • Engineering and platform teams: building the models into automated systems

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, value engineering or management consulting, ideally at a large consulting firm, financial services company or technology vendor.
  • Deep financial analysis and modelling skills, with a strong grasp of cash flow, P&L and financial accounting, including CapEx versus OpEx, depreciation and subscription models.
  • Deep knowledge of ROI and TCO, and the practical use of IRR, NPV and payback to justify business cases.
  • The ability to turn complex technical and commercial information into clear, defensible financial logic.
  • A rigorous approach to assumptions, data quality and version control.
  • Strong written and verbal communication of both qualitative and quantitative business cases, including the ability to turn financial outputs into a compelling narrative for non-finance audiences.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially sales, product, monetisation and platform teams.
  • Self-managed, responsive and curious, with the creativity to find new, sound ways to quantify value.

Preferred Background

  • A professional accounting or finance qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA, or a Master's degree with a financial background.
  • Pre-sales or commercial finance experience at a technology vendor.
  • Knowledge of enterprise technology or IT infrastructure.

The Role

You will join Everpure’s Datastore team to design, develop, and validate embedded firmware for our DirectFlash™ modules. In this role, you will work across firmware and hardware boundaries to build reliable, high-performance storage solutions, while also developing virtual platforms and tooling that accelerate development, debugging, and validation. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex system-level problems and help deliver innovative products to market. Comment end  

What You Will Be Doing

Everpure is seeking a full-time Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our device firmware team. You will be responsible for developing high-fidelity virtual platforms that abstract complex hardware behaviors to accelerate SSD firmware development. In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing and maintaining comprehensive firmware simulation environments (e.g., QEMU) to enable shift-left testing, reducing dependency on physical hardware and accelerating time-to-market.
  • Creating accurate, high-fidelity hardware models to abstract controller logic, communication interfaces (PCIe, NVMe), and NAND media behaviors within Pure Storage’s DirectFlash™ SSD Modules.
  • Designing and implementing instrumentation tools to profile performance and analyze failures within the simulated environment.
  • Automating CI/CD pipelines to seamlessly integrate simulation and virtual platforms into our firmware release and validation processes.
  • Partnering closely with ASIC vendors to validate firmware behaviors against RTL and digital logic designs before physical silicon is available.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5+ years of experience building and scaling complex embedded, firmware, or hardware-software systems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ (object oriented design and C++ 11 and onwards) and strong Python skills for both firmware and modeling development.
  • Deep understanding of firmware-hardware interaction, including the ability to translate complex schematics and data sheets into abstract software models.
  • Solid Linux (kernel, bootloaders) understanding and ability to root‑cause across HW/FW boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of high-performance storage protocols such as PCIe and NVMe.
  • Experience with embedded software development, RTOS and SoC and hardware bring-up.

title: Business Process Manager, Partner Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE:

Everpure goes to market through partners, and every partner interaction depends on a business process: how a partner is onboarded, how program compliance is done, how exceptions are submitted, reviewed and approved, how new business requirements reach IT. Today, much of that knowledge lives in people's heads. We are seeking a hands-on business process leader to change that.

As a Business Process Manager, you will own the development and documentation of every business process related to partners. You will capture how work actually gets done today, build a single, trusted source of truth for partner processes, and use it to drive standardization, improvement and automation. You will work closely with the GPO teams, Partner Operations, and our partners to become the go-to expert on how partner work flows across Everpure.

This role is ideal for someone who loves bringing structure to ambiguity, is equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with process owners and in the details of a swimlane diagram, and is motivated by seeing documented processes turn into a better partner experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Document the end-to-end partner process landscape
    • Build and maintain a partner process inventory, from partner recruitment and onboarding through deal registration, quoting, ordering, programs, incentives and offboarding
    • Work with process owners to document current-state policy, process and system flows, including roles and responsibilities (RACI), hand-offs, dependencies, control points and system integrations
    • Define and document how exceptions are requested, approved, tracked and closed
    • Document how GPO business requirements are captured, prioritized and handed off to Digital Transformation, in partnership with Business Systems Analysts
  • Establish process standards and governance
    • Create standard templates, notation and naming conventions for process maps, SOPs and work instructions
    • Stand up a central, easy-to-find process library and keep it current as programs, policies and systems change
    • Define process ownership and a regular review cadence so documentation stays accurate and trusted
    • Partner with Partner Operations, Finance, Legal and Internal Audit as needed on policy and control requirements
    • Advise process owners and GPO leaders on process design, controls and policy changes
  • Drive process improvement
    • Identify gaps, redundancies and manual work that create friction for partners, the field or internal teams
    • Lead efforts to simplify and standardize core processes and eliminate low-value work
    • Identify opportunities for automation and partner self-service, including AI use cases, and help shape requirements for system changes
    • Measure process performance (cycle time, exception volume, rework) and track improvements over time
    • May lead the work of others on process documentation and improvement projects
  • Enable adoption
    • Work with the Enablement and Change Management teams to turn documented processes into training, playbooks and partner-facing guidance
    • Make sure process changes are communicated clearly to internal teams and partners before they go live
    • Support projects and system implementations with process expertise, user acceptance testing input and post-launch reviews
    • Provide clear, concise readouts to GPO leadership on process health, risks and priorities

WHAT YOU’LL BRING...

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in business process management, business operations, sales/partner operations or consulting, ideally within a B2B technology company
  • Proven experience documenting complex, cross-functional processes from scratch and building a process library others rely on

District Managers serve as the engine driving our revenue strategy. The Sales Operations Business Partner directly addresses this challenge by assuming ownership of these functions.

Operating within a designated group of districts across the AMER Enterprise or Commercial segment, you will collaborate closely with District Managers to drive operational workflow, maintain data integrity, and interface with key partners across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Channel, and SEs among other teams. By streamlining operational tasks, you enable DMs to dedicate more focus to team coaching and deal execution. While forecast ownership and team leadership remain with the DM, your mandate is to deliver precise, timely, and fully managed support across underlying Sales processes.

This role is a trusted business partner position requiring strong analytical abilities, business partnering, and strong communication skills. It serves as a key pillar for operational execution in Sales Operations. As you partner with leadership, optimize district workflows, and manage cross-departmental coordination, the role offers a path toward Sales Operations Manager and Senior Sales Operations Manager positions—bringing expanded scope, increased strategic influence, and elevated partnership with senior sales leadership.

What you will do

  • Pipeline hygiene. Track pipeline quality in Salesforce and Clari across your districts. Follow up with AEs to update and clean opportunities, and flag hygiene gaps to the DM.
  • Forecast preparation. Pull district data ahead of weekly forecast calls, flag anomalies and changes, and prepare the roll-up the DM reviews.
  • Escalation triage. Take in customer and internal escalations, route them to the right team, and track each one to resolution so the DM is not the default inbox.
  • Deal Desk coordination. As required, follow up on Deal Desk requests and communicate approval status back to the DM and AE.
  • POC and expedite tracking. Monitor POC and expedite requests, keep stakeholders updated, and coordinate logistics across teams.
  • QSR preparation. Pull District data and build pre-work for Quarterly Sales Reviews, then track post-meeting action items to closure.
  • Annual planning support. Support territory and district data analysis, capacity modeling, and annual planning preparation.
  • Cross-functional coordination. Act as the district’s day-to-day contact for Finance, Legal, Channel, Marketing, and SE teams on operational requests.
  • Requests and cadence. Handle reporting requests and operational asks from DMs, and keep a working cadence (a weekly sync with each DM plus forecast call support).

How this role fits

You will work alongside the Regional Sales Operations team, which owns region-wide consistency, governance, and leadership reporting. Your focus is narrower and deeper: the day-to-day operations of your assigned districts. Forecast commits, deal strategy, AE coaching, and executive customer relationships stay with the District Manager.

What success looks like in your first six months

  • Your DMs report more time spent coaching AEs and less time on operational work.
  • Deal Desk and escalation cycle times in your districts get faster.
  • Pipeline hygiene in your districts improves and forecast calls start from clean data.
  • QSR prep takes your DMs noticeably less time, while delivering higher value insights.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, or another analytical, business-facing role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce; experience with Clari or a similar forecasting tool is a plus.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. High familiarity with using AI to build dashboards, synthesize data, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Very organized, with a habit of following things through to the end across many open requests at once.
  • Track record of acting as a business partner, not just a reporting resource 
  • Comfortable holding sales teams to process (for example, asking AEs to update pipeline) in a way that builds trust.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to summarize data simply for busy sales leaders.

THE ROLE:

Everpure is hiring a Consulting Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to be the senior technical lead on a portfolio of the world’s largest and most strategic financial institutions: global banks, asset managers and payment networks. The CSE owns the technical strategy for each account, earns the trust of architects, platform owners and technology executives, and orchestrates product specialists, professional services and partners to win multi-year, multi-million dollar platform decisions. This seat sits at the center of the decisions the largest financial institutions are making right now: how to build AI infrastructure on data they cannot move, how to modernize data platforms without adding operational risk, and how to meet rising resilience and regulatory expectations at lower cost. The CSE shapes those decisions directly, works with senior account teams, and has visibility with Everpure leadership across sales, product and engineering.

The right person is as comfortable whiteboarding data architecture with a bank’s chief architect as they are leading a competitive bake-off or answering a 200-line RFI with precision.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain the technical account plan: the customer’s architecture, their constraints and roadmap, where Everpure is deployed today, where the whitespace is, and which plays we run next. 
  • Become the go-to technical counterpart for infrastructure architects, storage and platform engineering leaders, and technology executives. 
  • Lead the technical side of complex pursuits from discovery through decision, including solution design, sizing, RFI and RFP responses, proofs of concept, lab evaluations and head-to-head competitive bake-offs.
  • Help customers design the container, storage and data layer for AI at scale: GPU cluster storage, inference and cache offload, retrieval and analytics pipelines, and governed data in place.
  • Run motions around Kubernetes and OpenShift data services, virtualization transitions, NVMe over TCP and Ethernet block, object storage, and cyber resilience. 
  • Pull in the right specialists, professional services and partner engineers at the right moment, keep them aligned on one plan, and hold the technical workstreams to owners, dates and a clear definition of done.
  • Partner with the GAM on account planning, forecast and pipeline hygiene.
  • Represent the requirements of the most demanding financial institutions back to product management, and help shape roadmap priorities with specific, evidence-based input.

WHAT YOU BRING 

  • Ten or more years in enterprise infrastructure, with at least five in a customer-facing presales, solutions architecture or field engineering role. 
  • Direct experience covering large financial services institutions is strongly expected.
  • Hands-on command of enterprise block, file and object storage, data protection and replication, and how they behave under real production load.
  • Working fluency across virtualization, Kubernetes and container platforms (OpenShift in particular), networking for storage (Ethernet, NVMe over TCP, RDMA, Fibre Channel), and at least one major public cloud.
  • Strong Executive communication skills
  • A track record of winning technical evaluations against established storage and infrastructure vendors, and of building displacement cases that survive customer scrutiny.
  • Familiarity with analytics and lakehouse platforms, data governance and data discovery, and how data placement decisions affect cost, compliance and AI readiness strongly preferred
  • Exposure to GPU infrastructure and AI workloads, such as NVIDIA DGX and SuperPOD reference architectures, GPUDirect Storage, inference serving frameworks (vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d) and the storage patterns behind training, inference and retrieval is a plus
  • Relevant certifications a plus (Kubernetes, Red Hat, cloud, NVIDIA or major storage platforms) preferred
  • Prior experience with Everpure FlashArray, FlashBlade or Portworx, from either the vendor or customer side, is a plus but not required.

title: Sales Operations Business Partner, Commercial
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

About the role

District Managers serve as the engine driving our revenue strategy. However, administrative and tactical tasks—such as gathering pipeline updates, managing escalations, and assembling QSR materials—frequently detract from their primary focus. The Sales Operations Business Partner directly addresses this challenge by assuming ownership of these functions.

Operating within a designated group of districts across the AMER Enterprise or Commercial segment, you will collaborate closely with District Managers to drive operational workflow, maintain data integrity, and interface with key partners across Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Channel, and SEs among other teams. By streamlining operational tasks, you enable DMs to dedicate more focus to team coaching and deal execution. While forecast ownership and team leadership remain with the DM, your mandate is to deliver precise, timely, and fully managed support across underlying Sales processes.

This role is a trusted business partner position requiring strong analytical abilities, business partnering, and strong communication skills. It serves as a key pillar for operational execution in Sales Operations. As you partner with leadership, optimize district workflows, and manage cross-departmental coordination, the role offers a path toward Sales Operations Manager and Senior Sales Operations Manager positions—bringing expanded scope, increased strategic influence, and elevated partnership with senior sales leadership.

What you will do

  • Pipeline hygiene. Track pipeline quality in Salesforce and Clari across your districts. Follow up with AEs to update and clean opportunities, and flag hygiene gaps to the DM.
  • Forecast preparation. Pull district data ahead of weekly forecast calls, flag anomalies and changes, and prepare the roll-up the DM reviews.
  • Escalation triage. Take in customer and internal escalations, route them to the right team, and track each one to resolution so the DM is not the default inbox.
  • Deal Desk coordination. As required, follow up on Deal Desk requests and communicate approval status back to the DM and AE.
  • POC and expedite tracking. Monitor POC and expedite requests, keep stakeholders updated, and coordinate logistics across teams.
  • QSR preparation. Pull District data and build pre-work for Quarterly Sales Reviews, then track post-meeting action items to closure.
  • Annual planning support. Support territory and district data analysis, capacity modeling, and annual planning preparation.
  • Cross-functional coordination. Act as the district’s day-to-day contact for Finance, Legal, Channel, Marketing, and SE teams on operational requests.

descriptionHtml:

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Michigan or Indiana

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, data scientists, researchers, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required

  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers
  • Familiarity with HPC, research and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation

title: Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer, Higher Education (Texas)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Texas

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required:

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, data scientists, researchers, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required:

  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers
  • Familiarity with HPC, research and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation

If you meet most of the required list and few of the second list, we would still like to hear from you.
