THE ROLE

About the team

The CPBU Security organization builds the security capabilities of Purity, the software that powers FlashArray and FlashBlade. Customers use these features directly, and they underpin the products’ industry certifications. 

The Service IAM team owns service-to-service identity and authorization. Our work covers OAuth and token exchange, container authorization, API clients, and the IAM middleware that sits in front of the products’ APIs.

How we work

We spend about 80% of our time designing and implementing product features. The other 20% goes to upholding our security posture through threat models, security reviews and similar activities.

Because security spans multiple layers of the software stack, our engineers write code in several languages (C++, Java, Python and Go), depending on the feature they’re building.

We work closely with colleagues in Prague and the US.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a technical lead to drive architecture and execution across projects that span multiple teams. You take ownership, and you build alignment with stakeholders on open-ended problems through data-driven decisions and earned credibility. You also coach senior and junior engineers, raise the technical bar, and guide career growth on the technical track.

This is a software engineering role in security, and you don’t need prior security experience. Security is the domain you’ll learn on the job while building features. We support you with structured onboarding, thorough documentation, AI tools that help you find context quickly, and colleagues who are glad to bring you up to speed.

Why join

Our team’s goals directly support company priorities, so your work has a visible impact. Security is a market differentiator for our products.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and implement creative new algorithms and technologies for high-performance, highly reliable systems (think six 9’s)
  • Own and deliver FlashArray and FlashBlade product security features end-to-end, from concept to shipped product

  • Work as a team with smart peers who inspire you and who are inspired by you
  • Make customers really happy, because that’s why we do what we do

Role Mandate

This role is the senior search strategist for Everpure's most consequential leadership appointments. The Principal Executive Recruiter leads searches at the Director level and above across every function and every region, advising the Executive Leadership Team and functional leaders on Everpure’s executive talent needs. The mandate is to bring the rigor of a retained search firm, and the institutional insight only an internal partner can provide, to the leadership hires that determine how fully Everpure delivers its platform strategy as it moves from storage to enterprise data management for the AI era.

Business Context

Talent Drivers

Everpure's ability to execute its platform strategy is increasingly tied to:

  • Leadership capacity to build and scale a platform-based, subscription-led enterprise
  • Access to senior talent in highly contested markets across enterprise infrastructure, data platforms, AI and cloud, in every region where Everpure operates
  • A consistent standard of mandate definition, assessment and offer construction across functions and geographies

Scope & Span

  • Global ownership of executive searches at the Director level and above, across engineering, product, go-to-market, finance, operations and corporate functions
  • Organization-agnostic remit, with a view of leadership demand and talent supply across the whole enterprise
  • Advisory relationship with the Executive Leadership Team and functional leaders on talent strategy, market intelligence and leadership team design
  • Close partnership with Total Rewards, HR Business Partners and the Talent Transformation team
  • Responsibility for the disciplined, confidential use of AI in executive research, sourcing and analysis

Core Outcomes

Align Executive Search to the Platform Growth Strategy

  • Translate enterprise strategy and organizational design into precise leadership mandates, with defined outcomes 
  • Shape unsettled or evolving needs into defensible mandates rather than waiting for certainty
  • Anticipate leadership capability gaps across the enterprise and inform how teams are assembled

Raise the Standard of Leadership Hiring

  • Lead each search from strategic market mapping through appointment, with a rationale for every target company and talent pool, including adjacent industries and non-obvious sources of talent
  • Assess candidates through structured, evidence-based methods and reconcile differing stakeholder views into clear, defensible decisions
  • Build breadth of experience and background into every slate from the outset
  • Structure and negotiate offers that reflect Everpure's total rewards philosophy, internal equity and executive leveling

Embed Search in the People Operating Model

  • Develop each offer with Total Rewards, grounded in market data, leveling and internal equity, including across jurisdictions
  • Work with HR Business Partners to reflect each organization's design, leadership dynamics and cultural context in mandates and assessment
  • Support strategic succession planning by connecting external market intelligence to leadership continuity, so that the decision to hire externally is informed by the strength of the internal bench
  • Align external search with internal succession, development and mobility in partnership with the Talent Transformation team

Build a High-Impact Search Practice

  • Apply AI to broaden and sharpen research, market mapping and analysis, with the Search Partner's judgment determining who merits engagement
  • Cultivate lasting relationships with senior leaders across Everpure's talent markets, so that its leadership brand is established before a role opens
  • Contribute to the standards, tools and operating model of the Executive Search function, and mentor colleagues across Talent Acquisition

Leadership Imperatives

Strategic Counselor

Connects business strategy with leadership requirements and advises senior executives with independent judgment, including a willingness to challenge prevailing views.

Comfort with Ambiguity

Operates with composure and clarity where priorities shift and mandates are incomplete. Creates structure instead of waiting for it.

Bias for Action

Moves early and with purpose, anticipates obstacles and makes sound decisions on imperfect information. Pace is driven by judgment and conviction rather than haste.

Global Mindset

Approaches leadership talent without regional assumptions. Understands how executive markets, compensation norms and candidate motivations differ across geographies.

Executive Presence

Credible with the CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Board audiences. Prepares analytical, decision-ready narratives.

Assessment Craft

Calibrated understanding of excellence at each leadership level and across functions. Applies structured, evidence-based assessment and holds the bar.

Market Authority

Credibility across multiple executive talent markets. Depth in enterprise technology is valued, and breadth across go-to-market, finance and corporate functions is a distinguishing strength.

AI Fluency

Practical use of AI-enabled research, sourcing and analysis, paired with sound judgment about its limits and a firm commitment to candidate and company confidentiality.

Cross-Functional Influencer

Builds alignment across executives, HR Business Partners, Total Rewards and Talent Transformation.

Search Leadership

Established record of executive search at the Director level and above, in a leading retained firm, an in-house retained practice or both, including multi-region searches and command of executive compensation, including equity.

Success Measures

  • Performance and retention of appointed leaders at twelve and twenty-four months
  • Executive and hiring manager confidence in mandate quality, slate quality and assessment
  • Slates that reflect breadth of experience and background
  • Offer acceptance rates for priority appointments
  • Appointment timelines that meet business need without compromising assessment rigor
  • Consistent search standards across functions and regions

Qualifications

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience with executive searches (Director+) and 12+ total recruiting experience; both in-house as well as with one of the leading executive search firms
  • Technical Domain Expertise: Proven experience recruiting executive talent in a highly technical and/or rapidly scaling environment (e.g., hardware, software, AI/ML, autonomous systems, high-growth tech).
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and present to C-level executives.
  • Closing: Expert-level negotiation and closing skills, particularly for complex executive compensation packages.
  • Executive Sourcing & Talent Mapping: Providing real-time competitive intelligence and talent benchmarking to the executive team, identifying shifts in the talent landscapes that may necessitate pivots. The ability to design and execute research strategies (sourcing) is a must.

THE ROLE

Portworx by Everpure is the leading global solution for unlocking the potential of Kubernetes by unlocking the power of data at enterprise scale.  Portworx is a cloud native platform that enterprises depend on to reduce the cost and complexity of rapidly deploying containerized applications across multiple clouds and on-prem environments.  By providing a single standard that works across the environment, we reduce the operating cost of kubernetes, unlock more use cases, respond and pivot to changes due to economic, regulatory and/or business impacts and make it easier to modernize applications, delight developers, and deliver innovation.

Via Portworx, you can manage any database or stateful service on any infrastructure using any container scheduler. You get a single data management layer for all of your stateful services, no matter where they run. And we thrive in multi-cloud environments.

We are looking for Kubernetes experts to help our team capture this massive and rapidly growing market opportunity.  This architect role will serve as the vanguard of the “Kubernetes Everywhere” movement. There’s no safe harbor here for those that can’t, don't, or won’t. There’s also no room for those that put “I” ahead of “We”.

We are customer first, we lead with integrity, and recognize that unlocking achievement requires engagement across the full spectrum of co-selling partners. We are builders, creators, and helping define the next generation of the world’s best modern data platform at Pure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Portworx Cloud Native Architect is a customer-facing role responsible for providing deep technical and business expertise to customers who want to run stateful applications in containers and automate “Day 2” data management workflows. 

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 5+ years' experience as a customer facing senior-level technical architect.
  • Charismatic, confident, and likable self-starter with a track record of success on stage, in the spotlight, and with customers.
  • Team oriented leader that is able to coach and drive desired behavior through influence rather than title.
  • 5+ years of Linux Administration and/or Linux development experience with an industry recognized administration-level or higher certification.
  • 3+ years of Kubernetes Administration experience and a KCNA (Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate) or above certification.
  • Certification-level fluency in OpenShift, Rancher, or other Kubernetes orchestration environment.
  • Certification-level fluency in Cloud IaaS environments such as VMware, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform and OpenStack.
  • Certification-level fluency with DevOps concepts and hands-on experience with associated tools, such as; Ansible, Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline applications.
  • Certification-level fluency in data engineering, big data, and database operations, delivery and operational services.
  • Demonstrable understanding of data platform technologies as they relate to highly available business applications on-prem, hybrid, and in the cloud
  • Demonstrable understanding of the enterprise application development lifecycle and container platforms’ effect on it.
  • Demonstrable ability to see and present ‘the big picture’ e.g. thought leadership, offer solutions to improve upon it, and challenge the status quo when it is not in alignment with or in the best interest of desired customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrable ability to distill complex problems into a simplified vision that drives customer interest in Everpure technologies

title: Python Software Engineer - Infrastructure & Platform
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The role

Our Site Reliability Engineering team builds and maintains the core software, automation, and platform services that power engineering across Everpure. We approach reliability as a software problem: building developer tooling, automating complex operational workflows in Python, designing observable systems, and ensuring our internal platform scales seamlessly.

As a Python Software Engineer in Prague with a passion for infrastructure, you will write the software and tooling that keep our platform services reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly. You will collaborate closely with product engineering teams and platform developers across our global sites to automate infrastructure management and build self-healing systems.

What you'll do

Python Tooling & Infrastructure Automation: Treat operations and infrastructure as software engineering problems. Design, build, and maintain Python-based automation, developer CLI tools, self-healing systems, and custom services that simplify deployment, monitoring, and platform operations.

Observability: Help build and operate a consistent pipeline for metrics, logs and alerts across our data centres and public cloud. Improve detection speed and alert quality so that engineers are paged only when action is needed and have the context they need when they are.

Incident management: Take part in the on-call rotation for the services you own, respond to and coordinate incidents, and run blameless postmortems. Turn what incidents reveal into durable fixes, runbooks and automation, and help keep on-call sustainable for the team.

Shared platform services: Operate the messaging, caching, database and continuous-integration services the platform depends on. Contribute to making them highly available: redundancy, capacity planning, upgrades and tested recovery procedures.

Automation: Treat operations as an engineering problem. Build the tooling that removes repetitive work, from deployment and configuration automation to health checks and self-healing, and contribute to our work applying AI to incident triage and remediation.

Production readiness: Take part in design and production-readiness reviews, capacity planning and launch support for new services, and help product teams adopt reliability practices so that fewer problems reach production.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

What you bring

Our platform runs on Kubernetes across our own data centres and public cloud, and most of our tooling is written in Python and Go.
